Accordion.description:
Header = the dark full pill (58 tall) with a white title and a caret that turns
180° when open; content `body` in `color.text.tertiary`, padding 12/28/8; items 8 apart.
WAI-ARIA accordion: heading > button[aria-expanded][aria-controls] + role=region.

props.name: collapsible
props.description: `single` only: allow closing the open item (default true).

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initially open item values (uncontrolled).

props.name: headingLevel
props.description: Heading level wrapping each header button. Default 3.

props.name: type
props.description: `single` (default): opening an item closes the others. `multiple`: independent items.

props.name: value
props.description: Open item values (controlled).

props.name: variant
props.description: Default `default`.

props.name: title
props.description: Header title.

props.name: value
props.description: Unique value within the Accordion.

props.name: meta
props.description: Optional trailing node in the header, before the caret (a count, a badge…).

props.name: pressed
props.description: Force the header's pressed look (visual tests).

props.name: play
props.description: Rising edge (false → true) plays the wipe once; set it back to false (e.g. in onDone) to arm it again.

props.name: agentColor
props.description: Tint of the chevron panels (= `SweepTransition tone="<colour>"`). Default: sage / teal / deep.

props.name: at
props.description: Freeze the timeline at this time in ms (of `duration`) for demos / visual tests; renders regardless of `active`.

props.name: container
props.description: Render inside this element (position: absolute) instead of a fixed layer on `<body>`.

props.name: label
props.description: Band text (default "Agent Select").

props.name: onDone
props.description: The sweep has finished and unmounted.

props.name: onMidpoint
props.description: The screen is fully covered: swap the content underneath here.

props.name: reducedMotion
props.description: Force (true) or suppress (false) the reduced-motion quick fade. Default: the OS setting / a `data-reduced-motion` ancestor.

BarChart.description:
Simple categorical bar chart (vertical bars): score distributions, poll results, stats.
Dark hatched tracks, token fills, highlighted bar(s) in the live accent with a marker tag,
sheared heavy labels, bars that grow on mount.

Accessibility: the drawing is one `role="img"` named by a generated summary (count, highest
bar, highlighted bars); a visually hidden `<table>` next to it carries every value and share.

props.name: animate
props.description: Grow the bars on mount (always off under prefers-reduced-motion). Default true.

props.name: fill
props.description: Fill of normal bars. Default `muted`.

props.name: formatValue
props.type: ((value: number, datum: BarChartDatum, share: number) => ReactNode)
props.description: Custom value text (wins over `valueDisplay` unless that is `none`).

props.name: height
props.description: Plot height in design units (the tallest bar). Default 280.

props.name: highlight
props.description: Index (or indices) of highlighted bars, in addition to `datum.highlight`.

props.name: highlightFill
props.description: Fill of highlighted bars. Default `accent`.

props.name: label
props.description: Chart name: starts the generated summary and captions the data table. Default "Bar chart".

props.name: markerLabel
props.description: Marker tag above highlighted bars ("You").

props.name: max
props.description: Scale maximum. Default: the largest value.

props.name: summary
props.description: Replace the generated accessible summary.

props.name: valueDisplay
props.description: Default `value`. Percentages are of the sum of all values.

props.name: xAxisLabel
props.description: Axis title under the category labels.

props.name: yAxisLabel
props.description: Axis title left of the plot (rotated).

BottomBar.description:
Bottom bar: a solid black band, 100 tall, controls 57–58 tall on a row 22 below its top,
side margins 66. `Screen` places it in its
`<footer>` landmark; standalone it is a plain `div`.

props.name: hints
props.description: Key-hint row (e.g. "T Unlock", "R Discard / T Lock"), right-aligned inside the band.

props.name: left
props.description: Left group, from x 66 (Compare / Recommend, the filter circle…), 24 px apart.

props.name: right
props.description: Right group, ending at the right margin (Remove / Enhance…), 24 px apart.

props.name: separator
props.description: A faint separator line near the band top (5 tall, 6 below it).

Button.description:
The kit's dark pill button on the web control scale (`size` sm / md / lg).
No hover styling by design; pressed = live accent fill + outset (`:active`, Space held, a 100 ms Enter
flash, or `pressed`); disabled greys the label only.

props.name: avatar
props.description: Image in the cap instead of an icon (Special Training Plan). A string renders an ``.

props.name: cost
props.description:
`variant="marquee"`: a segment joined to the left of the pill with the price. It describes the button
(`aria-describedby`); only the pill is pressable. `className`, `style` and `ref` stay on the button.

props.name: fit
props.description:
Auto-shrink a long label to the pill (auto-size, e.g. "Recommend").
Default: on for fixed widths and mission buttons, off for `auto`/two-line.

props.name: href
props.description: Render as `<a href>` (navigation that looks like a button).

props.name: icon
props.description: Glyph in the leading icon cap (or the centred glyph of `variant="sub"`).

props.name: iconTone
props.description: Disc colour behind `icon`. Default `plain` (white glyph on the black cap, e.g. City's house, Filter's funnel).

props.name: marqueeText
props.description: `variant="marquee"`: the words drifting behind the label, drawn upper-case. Default: the label, when it is a string.

props.name: missionState
props.description: `variant="mission"` only.

props.name: pressed
props.description: Force the pressed look (tests, externally driven presses).

props.name: pressOutset
props.description:
Pressed outset in design units. Default: `size.control.pressOutset` (4) scaled with `size`
(≈ 3.2 on `sm`, 4.8 on `lg`). Dialog buttons use 0 (the default for `width="dialog"`).
An explicit value is absolute (not scaled by `size`).

props.name: size
props.description: Control size: `sm` 46 · `md` 57 · `lg` 69 design units (≈ 32 / 40 / 48 px at the default scale). Default `md`.

props.name: still
props.description: Stop the drifting background of `event` / `marquee` (it also stops under `prefers-reduced-motion`).

props.name: twoLine
props.description: Two-line label ("Stat / Bonuses"): smaller type, `lineHeight.buttonTwoLine` 22. `\n` in a string breaks the line.

props.name: variant
props.description: Default `default`.

props.name: width
props.description: Default `auto`.

Capsule.description:
The black pill under item cards: level / count / EMPTY. It fills its container's
width (the card width) and centres one line of text. Not interactive.

props.name: children
props.description: Content. The `empty` tone defaults to "EMPTY".

props.name: size
props.description: Height: `sm` 23 (EMPTY slots), `md` 24 (cards, default), `lg` 27 (ingredient tiles).

props.name: tone
props.description:
`default`: white upright `fontSize.label` ("Lv. 60", "×30", "20/60").
`empty`: condensed `condensedSm` "EMPTY" in `color.text.faint`.
`danger`: `color.danger.text` (insufficient count). Default `default`.

CategoryTag.description:
News category tag: a 26 px black tag,
round left end, slanted right end, lime micro text. Static label (not interactive).

props.name: skin
props.description: `web` (default): `#BFDB5A` text. `game`: the live `--zzz-accent`.

Checkbox.description:
A native checkbox drawn as a 24 px box (radius 5, 3 px `color.border.button` ring, 1 px black
keyline) with a `body` label in `color.text.secondary`. Checked: live accent fill + black
check, label white. Disabled: `color.text.disabled`. Row height 40. Sizes sm / md / lg.

`className` / `style` go to the root `<label>`; `ref` and other props to the `<input>`.

props.name: checked
props.description: Checked (controlled).

props.name: children
props.description: Visible label.

props.name: defaultChecked
props.description: Initial state (uncontrolled).

props.name: indeterminate
props.description: Mixed state ("some selected"): a black bar on the accent box; `aria-checked="mixed"`.

props.name: size
props.description:
Box, ring, check and row height scale with the control scale (sm = md × 46/57, lg = md × 69/57);
the label is `fontSize.label` / `body` / `bodyLg`. Default `md`.

CheckInCalendar.description:
Daily check-in calendar:
`CheckInTile` tickets 141 × 265 in a grid at a 144 × 277.5 pitch. An ordered list; each tile is named
"Day 1, 30 × item, claimed".

props.name: days
props.description: One entry per day, in order.

props.name: columns
props.description: Tiles per row. Default 7 (e.g. 7 × 2 at a 144 × 277.5 pitch).

CheckInTile.description:
One daily check-in "ticket": 141 × 265 silver frame
with perforated side strips, a yellow (pink on special days) art window, a black item-type disc, a red day disc
(68 px circle clipped by the ticket's top-right corner to 57 × 61, "01" over "DAY"), a dashed perforation line and a 50 px dark count
strip with "× 30" in a black capsule. Claimed: a static lime tick over the art and a grey count.
Display only (claiming is handled by the page, not the tile).

props.name: count
props.description: Quantity ("× 30").

props.name: day
props.description: Day number (1-based). Rendered zero-padded ("01") in the red disc.

props.name: claimed
props.description: Day already claimed: static lime tick over the art, greyed count.

props.name: item
props.description: Reward art slot (an ``, `` or SVG), ~90 px, centred in the art window.

props.name: itemName
props.description: Reward name for the accessible name ("Day 1, 30 × Film, claimed").

props.name: special
props.description: Special reward day: pink art window instead of yellow.

props.name: tag
props.description: Red tag over the art bottom (e.g. "Outfit Select"). `\n` breaks the line.

props.name: typeIcon
props.description: Glyph in the small black disc at the top-left (item type). Default: a cube. `null` hides the disc.

props.name: defaultSelected
props.description: Initial selected state (uncontrolled).

props.name: onSelectedChange
props.description: Called with the next selected state on click / Enter / Space.

props.name: pressed
props.description: Force the pressed look (visual tests).

props.name: selected
props.description: Selected (controlled): accent fill + black label.

props.name: size
props.description:
Control size (default `md`). Width, height, ring, padding, label and the pressed outset scale by
the control-size ratio (sm 46/57, lg 69/57); the label never drops below the `label` text role.

ChipGroup.description:
Filter section: a muted section label above a grid of `Chip`s,
2 columns, 262 × 41 chips, 19–20 px column gap, 57 px row pitch.

- `multiple` (default): `role="group"`, chips are `checkbox`es; every chip is tabbable and
  ←/→/↑/↓/Home/End also move focus.
- `multiple={false}`: `role="radiogroup"`, chips are `radio`s with a roving tab stop; arrows
  move focus AND select (WAI-ARIA radio group).

props.name: label
props.description: Section label shown above the grid ("Rarity", "Agent Specialties"); also the group's accessible name.

props.name: columns
props.description: Grid columns (default 2, the drawer layout).

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initial selected values (uncontrolled).

props.name: hideLabel
props.description: Hide the visible label (it still names the group).

props.name: multiple
props.description: Multi-select (default, checkboxes) or single-select (`false`, radios).

props.name: size
props.description: Size of every chip (default `md`); the grid's column width and gaps scale with it.

props.name: value
props.description: Selected values (controlled). Always an array, also in single mode; kept in option order.

ChoiceButton.description:
A large selectable option on the dark pill material (ring + lit bevel + dot mesh), with an
optional round badge cap (like Button's icon cap), a heavy 10°-sheared label that wraps,
an optional description and an optional media slot. General purpose: quiz answers, polls,
onboarding pickers, plan selection, settings.

States: idle · selected (accent ring + accent cap, pulsing with the shared accent clock) ·
pressed (the shared accent-fill recipe) · disabled (grey label, shape unchanged) · results
`correct` / `incorrect` / `revealed`. The state is mirrored on `data-state`.
Standalone it is a toggle `<button aria-pressed>`; give it `role="radio" | "checkbox"` (as
ChoiceGroup does) and it reports `aria-checked` instead.

props.name: badge
props.description: Content of the leading round cap: a letter, a number or an icon. Omit for no cap.

props.name: children
props.description: The heavy, sheared label (wraps to 2–3 lines).

props.name: correctTone
props.description: Default `green`.

props.name: description
props.description: Secondary line under the label (upright, muted). Exposed as the accessible description.

props.name: media
props.description: Image / avatar / SVG slot (decorative: it is hidden from assistive tech, so the label must stand alone).

props.name: mediaLayout
props.description: Default `inline`.

props.name: pressed
props.description: Force the pressed look (tests, externally driven presses).

props.name: result
props.description: Outcome; overrides the selected look.

props.name: resultLabel
props.description: Screen-reader text appended to the label for `result`. Defaults: "Correct", "Incorrect", "Correct answer".

props.name: selected
props.description: Selected look (pulsing accent ring + accent cap). Standalone buttons also get `aria-pressed`.

props.name: size
props.description:
`sm` / `md` / `lg` (default `md`): min-height 63 / 78 / 94, badge cap 45 / 56 / 68 design units,
label `fontSize.control.{sm,md,lg}` (21 / 26 / 30), description label / body / bodyLg; ring,
radius, padding, media and press outset scale with it. Mirrored on `data-size`.

props.name: value
props.description: Mirrored on `data-value` (handy for delegation and tests).

ChoiceGroup.description:
A set of ChoiceButtons with single (`radiogroup` of `radio`s) or multiple (`group` of
`checkbox`es) selection, controlled or uncontrolled. Keyboard: one Tab stop (roving), arrow
keys / Home / End move focus (grid-aware, wrapping, skipping disabled items), Space / Enter
select; optional single-key hotkeys. `results` + `locked` show outcomes, freeze the group and
announce them through a polite live region.

props.name: announcement
props.description:
Polite live-region text. Default: generated from `results` ("Tokyo: Incorrect. Correct answer:
Paris."). A string/node replaces it; `false` removes the live region (announce it yourself).

props.name: badges
props.description: Default `letters`.

props.name: columns
props.description: Grid columns on wide containers (default: 1 → 1, multiples of 3 → 3, otherwise 2 — four is 2×2). Narrow containers still collapse.

props.name: correctTone
props.description: Default `green`.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disable every item.

props.name: hotkeys
props.description:
Single-key selection by badge (1–9 / A–Z) or `item.hotkey`. `true`: while focus is inside the
group. `'global'`: anywhere on the page except text fields. Modifier combos are ignored.

props.name: label
props.description: Visible group label (also the accessible name). Without it pass `aria-label` / `aria-labelledby`.

props.name: layout
props.description: Default `grid`: auto columns (2×2 for four), one column in narrow containers. `list`: one column.

props.name: locked
props.description: Freeze the group (typically together with `results`): no selection changes; items stay focusable.

props.name: maxSelected
props.description: Ignore picks beyond this many.

props.name: mediaLayout
props.description: Default `inline`.

props.name: resultLabels
props.description: Screen-reader result words (i18n).

props.name: results
props.description: Outcome per value; items without an entry keep their normal state.

props.name: size
props.description: Size of every choice (`sm` / `md` / `lg`, default `md`); the gaps and the group label scale with it.

props.name: value
props.description: Selected value (controlled). `null` = nothing selected.

choiceState.description: Map a result (including the aliases) and the selected flag to the visual state.

ClaimedCheck.description:
Static lime "claimed" tick with a black outline (`color.checkIn.claimed` #B6F906, ~35 × 25; the
same tick marks a claimed reward on a mission card). Original SVG, decorative
(`aria-hidden`): the host states "claimed" in its accessible name. Sized by CSS (default 35 × 25 design units).

props.name: decorative
props.description: Hide from assistive tech when nearby text already says the same thing.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name. Every badge has a sensible default.

props.name: size
props.description: Diameter in design units. Default 40.

computePosition.description:
Pure placement maths (unit-tested). Places `floating` on `side` of `anchor` with `gap`,
flips to the opposite side when it does not fit but the opposite does, then clamps the
cross axis into the viewport with `margin`.

props.name: onConfirm
props.description: Confirm pressed; the dialog then closes (onOpenChange(false)).

props.name: title
props.description: The question / heading, centred at the top of the band (its accessible name).

props.name: backdrop
props.description: Blurred, striped scrim behind the band (default true).

props.name: cancelLabel
props.description: Default "Cancel".

props.name: children
props.description: Band content under the title (e.g. a RewardTileGroup).

props.name: closeOnEscape
props.description: Escape closes (default true).

props.name: confirmDisabled
props.description: Disable Confirm (e.g. insufficient materials).

props.name: confirmLabel
props.description: Default "Confirm".

props.name: container
props.description: Render inside this element (position: absolute) instead of a fixed layer on `<body>`.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Initial open state (uncontrolled).

props.name: freezePage
props.description: Freeze the page's accent pulse behind the dialog (default true).

props.name: initialFocus
props.description: Which button takes focus on open (default `confirm`).

props.name: onCancel
props.description: Cancel pressed or Escape; the dialog then closes.

props.name: onEscapeKeyDown
props.description: Called on Escape before the dialog closes (ConfirmDialog maps it to cancel).

props.name: open
props.description: Open state (controlled).

props.name: pixelate
props.description: ~100 ms pixelated freeze of the page before the band pops in (optional).

props.name: watermark
props.description: Drifting graffiti watermark inside the band (default true).

ContentCard.description:
A general content card on the panel material: header strip (eyebrow + trailing slot), large
heavy title, optional media (top or side), body and footer actions. Fluid width; a container
query moves side media under the title in narrow cards. Composed from the side / tool panel
materials.

props.name: as
props.description: Root element. Default `article`.

props.name: eyebrow
props.description: Small label at the left of the header strip ("Question 3 / 5", "Daily", "Settings").

props.name: footer
props.description: Footer actions (right-aligned, wrapping).

props.name: media
props.description: Image / art / SVG slot (sized with CSS: `object-fit: cover`).

props.name: mediaPosition
props.description: Default `top`.

props.name: title
props.description: Large heavy title; also the card's accessible name.

props.name: titleAs
props.description: Heading element for `title`. Default `h2`.

props.name: trailing
props.description: Right end of the header strip: a tag, timer, counter, icon button…

props.name: variant
props.description: Default `default`.

CopyButton.description:
Copy-to-clipboard button built on `Button`. Click → `navigator.clipboard` (textarea fallback)
→ "Copied" + check on a confirm disc for `resetAfter` ms, or "Copy failed" + cross on a cancel
disc. All three labels are stacked in one grid cell so the pill keeps the width of the widest
one; the result is announced through a polite `role="status"` region next to the button.

props.name: children
props.description: Idle label. Default "Copy".

props.name: copiedLabel
props.description: Label + live announcement after a successful copy. Default "Copied".

props.name: cost
props.description:
`variant="marquee"`: a segment joined to the left of the pill with the price. It describes the button
(`aria-describedby`); only the pill is pressable. `className`, `style` and `ref` stay on the button.

props.name: failedLabel
props.description: Label + live announcement when copying failed. Default "Copy failed".

props.name: fit
props.description:
Auto-shrink a long label to the pill (auto-size, e.g. "Recommend").
Default: on for fixed widths and mission buttons, off for `auto`/two-line.

props.name: getText
props.description: Lazy text (read at click time), e.g. a share message built from current state. May be async. Wins over `text`.

props.name: icon
props.description: Leading glyph while idle. Default the copy glyph; `null` for none (the status glyphs still show).

props.name: marqueeText
props.description: `variant="marquee"`: the words drifting behind the label, drawn upper-case. Default: the label, when it is a string.

props.name: onCopy
props.description: Called with the copied text.

props.name: onError
props.description: Called with the error when every copy method failed (or `getText` threw).

props.name: onStatusChange
props.description: Called whenever the status changes (after a copy and when it resets to idle).

props.name: pressed
props.description: Force the pressed look (tests, externally driven presses).

props.name: pressOutset
props.description:
Pressed outset in design units. Default: `size.control.pressOutset` (4) scaled with `size`
(≈ 3.2 on `sm`, 4.8 on `lg`). Dialog buttons use 0 (the default for `width="dialog"`).
An explicit value is absolute (not scaled by `size`).

props.name: resetAfter
props.description: How long the copied / failed state shows before returning to idle, ms. Default 2000.

props.name: size
props.description: Control size: `sm` 46 · `md` 57 · `lg` 69 design units (≈ 32 / 40 / 48 px at the default scale). Default `md`.

props.name: status
props.description: Controlled status (force the copied / failed look, or drive it from outside).

props.name: still
props.description: Stop the drifting background of `event` / `marquee` (it also stops under `prefers-reduced-motion`).

props.name: text
props.description: The text to copy.

props.name: width
props.description: Default `auto`.

CopyGlyphIcon.description: Original "two sheets" copy glyph on the 32 grid.

copyToClipboard.description:
Copy `text` to the clipboard: `navigator.clipboard.writeText` first, then the hidden-textarea
`execCommand('copy')` fallback (older browsers, insecure origins, denied permission).
Resolves when one of them succeeds, rejects with an `Error` otherwise.

Countdown.description:
Live countdown to a target instant ("Next puzzle in 07:42:13", "Event ends in 2d 07:42:13"),
ticking on each second (deadline-based via `useCountdown`, so background tabs stay exact).
InfoPill look by default; `variant="plain"` for inline text. `role="timer"` (not live): the
readout is never announced on every tick.

props.name: target
props.description: The instant to count down to (Date, epoch ms or a Date-parsable string).

props.name: format
props.description: Preset or a function of the remaining parts. Default 'auto'.

props.name: icon
props.description: Leading glyph (pill variant). Default a clock; `null` hides it.

props.name: onReach
props.description: Called once when the target is reached (again for a new target).

props.name: prefix
props.description: Text / node before the time, e.g. "Next puzzle in".

props.name: reachedLabel
props.description: Shown instead of the time once the target is reached (default: the zeroed time).

props.name: suffix
props.description: Text / node after the time, e.g. "left".

props.name: variant
props.description: 'pill' (default): black InfoPill look. 'plain': inline text that inherits the surrounding type.

CountdownBar.description:
Time-remaining bar: a ringed black pill with a hatched track and an accent fill that shrinks from
the right behind a slanted leading edge. At `warnAt` seconds it turns orange and pulses, at
`criticalAt` red; when it runs out the readout shows `expiredLabel`. Self-driven
(`durationMs` / `deadline` + `running` + `onExpire`, via `useCountdown`) or controlled
(`fraction` / `secondsLeft`, e.g. from your own `useCountdown`). Quizzes, cooldowns, sessions, auctions.

props.name: announceAt
props.description:
Whole seconds at which the polite live region speaks "N seconds left". Default `[warnAt]`.
Expiry is always announced. Pass `[]` (and `announceExpiry={false}`) to stay silent.

props.name: announceExpiry
props.description: Announce the expired label. Default true.

props.name: chevrons
props.description: Black ">" chevron cuts across the fill (overclock-bar texture). Default false.

props.name: criticalAt
props.description: Seconds at or below which it turns red. Default 3 (`0` disables).

props.name: deadline
props.description: Self-driven absolute end instant (instead of `durationMs`).

props.name: durationMs
props.description: Self-driven length in ms (also the 100 % reference for a controlled `secondsLeft`).

props.name: expired
props.description: Controlled override of the expired state (default: `secondsLeft === 0`, or `fraction === 0`).

props.name: expiredLabel
props.description: Label shown in place of the seconds once expired. Default "Time's up".

props.name: formatValue
props.description: Formats the seconds readout. Default `12s`, or `m:ss` from one minute up.

props.name: fraction
props.description: Controlled remaining fraction 1 → 0. Passing `fraction` or `secondsLeft` makes the bar controlled.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name of the progress bar. Default "Time remaining".

props.name: onExpire
props.description: Self-driven: called once when the time runs out.

props.name: running
props.description: Self-driven: whether the clock runs. Default true.

props.name: secondsLeft
props.description: Controlled remaining seconds (drives the label and the warning state).

props.name: showValue
props.description: Show the seconds readout beside the bar. Default true.

props.name: size
props.description:
Bar thickness and readout size. Default `md`. Channel 16 / 28 / 40 design units (≈ 11 / 20 / 28
CSS px at the default scale); readout `fontSize.control.{sm,md,lg}` (21 / 26 / 30).

props.name: warnAt
props.description: Seconds at or below which the bar turns orange and pulses. Default 10.

props.name: warning
props.description: Controlled override of the warning state (default: `secondsLeft <= warnAt`).

CurrencyPill.description:
Top-bar currency pill: a 222 × 56 outline (round left end, right tail leaning 25°)
drawn in SVG — ring `color.border.button`, `surface.button` fill with the dot mesh — holding a
zero-padded `bodyXl` counter, the item art on the tail and an optional "+" PlusBadge.

props.name: label
props.description: Currency name ("Dennies"); names the group and the "+" button.

props.name: value
props.description: Amount. Numbers are zero-padded to `digits`; strings render as given.

props.name: addLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the "+" button. Default "Get more {label}".

props.name: addProps
props.description: Extra props for the "+" button (`disabled`, `data-pressed`…).

props.name: digits
props.description: Digit count of the padded value. Default 8, or 3 when `max` is set; 0 = no padding.

props.name: icon
props.description: Item art on the tail (~40 × 49). Decorative.

props.name: max
props.description: Stamina: renders "value/max" (the max is never padded).

props.name: onAdd
props.description: Shows the "+" PlusBadge (a separate button "Get more {label}").

props.name: padTone
props.description: Colour of the padding zeros: `grey` (`color.text.zeroPad`) or `white` (stamina "020/240"). Default grey, white with `max`.

DialogBackdrop.description:
The modal scrim behind a DialogBand: the page seen through `blur(13)` plus the
static 39.8° two-stripe dimming `rgba(0,0,0,.55)` / `rgba(26,26,26,.66)` (`effect.dialogBackdrop`).
Decorative (`aria-hidden`); position: absolute, filling its layer.

props.name: pixelate
props.description:
Show a ~100 ms pixelated "freeze" of the page before the band appears (a coarse mosaic grid
over a light blur).

props.name: state
props.description: 'open' fades the stripes in (70 ms); 'closed' fades them out (100 ms after 60 ms) and keeps the blur.

DialogBand.description:
The kit's modal band: a full-width 390 px black band, vertically centred, with 4 px edge
lines, a drifting graffiti watermark, a centred title and a button row centred on the bottom edge line.
Portalled to `<body>` (or `container`), `role="dialog"` + `aria-modal`, focus trapped, Escape closes,
page scroll locked and page `inert`, focus restored on close.

Motion: band scaleY .87 → 1.023 → 1.015 → 1.009 → 1 in 140 ms with a white flash (.34 → 0, 100 ms)
and the content fading .27 → 1 in 70 ms; close = band opacity 0 in 60 ms, then the scrim.

props.name: title
props.description: The question / heading, centred at the top of the band (its accessible name).

props.name: actions
props.description: Button row straddling the bottom edge line (e.g. Cancel / Confirm `Button width="dialog"`).

props.name: alert
props.description: `alertdialog` instead of `dialog` (confirmations).

props.name: backdrop
props.description: Blurred, striped scrim behind the band (default true).

props.name: children
props.description: Band content under the title (e.g. a RewardTileGroup).

props.name: closeOnEscape
props.description: Escape closes (default true).

props.name: container
props.description: Render inside this element (position: absolute) instead of a fixed layer on `<body>`.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Initial open state (uncontrolled).

props.name: freezePage
props.description: Freeze the page's accent pulse behind the dialog (default true).

props.name: initialFocus
props.description: Element to focus on open. Default: the last button of `actions` (Confirm), else the first tabbable.

props.name: onEscapeKeyDown
props.description: Called on Escape before the dialog closes (ConfirmDialog maps it to cancel).

props.name: open
props.description: Open state (controlled).

props.name: pixelate
props.description: ~100 ms pixelated freeze of the page before the band pops in (optional).

props.name: watermark
props.description: Drifting graffiti watermark inside the band (default true).

DotTexture.description: Absolutely positioned diamond dot lattice (pattern.dots), transparent between the dots.

props.name: alpha
props.description: White alpha of the light dots (default 0.035).

props.name: shade
props.description: Black alpha of the dark dots between them (default 0).

props.name: size
props.description: Lattice pitch: `sm` 4.64 (pills), `md` 5.2 (drawer), `lg` 7 (textured headers). Default `sm`.

Drawer.description:
Right-anchored side sheet: 688 wide, full height, 4 px black left edge; black
95 px header (icon + upright title + red Close tag), `#1A1A1A` dotted body holding a `#030303`
inner panel (radius 12, margins 41 / 63 / 21 / 23), black 100 px footer with the action centred on
the inner panel. The page behind is dimmed by a left-to-right gradient (`effect.drawerScrim`), no blur.

Motion: in 200 ms `cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)` (translateX 100 % → 0), out 170 ms ease-in; the scrim fades
with it. Same accessibility as DialogBand: `role="dialog"` + `aria-modal`, focus trap, Escape closes,
page inert + scroll-locked, focus returns to the opener.

props.name: title
props.description: Header title (upright, `fontSize.button` 26); the dialog's accessible name.

props.name: closeLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the header Close tag (default "Close").

props.name: closeOnEscape
props.description: Escape closes (default true).

props.name: closeOnScrim
props.description: Close when the dimmed page (scrim) is clicked (default true).

props.name: container
props.description: Render inside this element (position: absolute) instead of a fixed layer on `<body>`.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Initial open state (uncontrolled).

props.name: footer
props.description: Footer action(s), centred on the inner panel (e.g. the Reset button).

props.name: icon
props.description: Header glyph before the title (e.g. `<FilterIcon />`, 21 × 22).

props.name: open
props.description: Open state (controlled).

props.name: width
props.description: Drawer width in design units (default 688, `size.panel.drawerWidth`).

DropdownMenu.description:
Dropdown menu. Panel #111 with a 3 px #323232 ring, radius 24, padding 4; items are 40-tall
full pills (padding 0 30) with a 4 px gap; the active item takes the live accent with a black
label; a 7.5 px accent bar runs across the top in the live accent.

WAI-ARIA menu button: Enter / Space / ↓ open on the first item, ↑ on the last; ↑ ↓ Home End move
(disabled items are skipped); typing jumps to a matching item; Enter / Space choose; Escape
closes and returns focus to the trigger; Tab / Shift+Tab close and move on from the trigger
(to the next / previous tabbable after it); a click outside closes.
`className` / `style` / `ref` / other div props go to the menu panel (`role="menu"`).

props.name: trigger
props.description: The menu button: ONE button element. It gets `aria-haspopup`, `aria-expanded`, `aria-controls`.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Initial open state (uncontrolled).

props.name: onSelect
props.description: Called with the chosen item's id.

props.name: open
props.description: Controlled open state.

props.name: placement
props.description: Default `bottom-start`; flips vertically when it does not fit.

props.name: topBar
props.description: The 7.5 px accent bar across the top. Default true.

props.name: width
props.description: Panel min-width in design units. Default 260.

EffectNameBar.description:
Full-width 38 px effect-name capsule, white `body` label, pad 18. With `expandable`, a
32 × 15 white inverted triangle overlaps the bar bottom by 2 px; it is a toggle button
(`aria-expanded`). Expanded: the triangle points up.

props.name: chevronPressed
props.description: Force the pressed look on the chevron (tests).

props.name: children
props.description: Effect name ("Scorching Breath").

props.name: controls
props.description: Id of the region the chevron expands (`aria-controls`).

props.name: defaultExpanded
props.description: Uncontrolled initial state. Default false.

props.name: expandable
props.description:
Show the white expand chevron (a `button` with `aria-expanded`) under the bar. The chevron hangs
13 px below the bar and reserves no layout space: leave at least 13 px before the next content.

props.name: expanded
props.description: Controlled expanded state.

props.name: expandLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the chevron button. Default "Show effect details".

props.name: surface
props.description:
Capsule fill: `panel` #161616 (side DETAIL panel), `sunken` #0D0D0D (big panel), `black` (equip
screen). Default `panel`.

EffectText.description:
Effect paragraph: white `fontSize.body`, weight 900, upright. Inline `<Keyword>` is the
orange specialty name (its icon renders as the 23 × 20 grey glyph with a 6 px gap) and `<Value>`
the green number.

props.name: as
props.description: Default `p`.

props.name: children
props.description: Paragraph content; use `<Keyword icon={…}>` and `<Value>` inline.

props.name: density
props.description: Default `compact`.

props.name: markup
props.description:
Plain-string alternative to `children` with a tiny markup: `{kw}Attack{/kw}` → `<Keyword>`,
`{val}3.5%{/val}` → `<Value>`, `{b}Basic Attack{/b}` → `<strong>`. Ignored when `children` is given.

props.name: tone
props.description:
`primary` (white body), `muted` (the grey "Next Phase" heading and next-phase paragraph; `<strong>`
inside it stays white, so changed words stand out). Default `primary`.

EmptyStatRow.description:
Empty stat slot: `statRowEmpty` #0C0C0C capsule, a centred condensed "EMPTY" in
`color.text.ghost`, flanked by two solid 4 px rules inset 13.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible term (the visible word is always "EMPTY"). Default "Empty slot".

props.name: variant
props.description: Default `grid` (the 300 × 40 big-panel capsule), or the enclosing StatGrid's variant.

EventDescription.description:
Event blurb under the title and info pills: `bodyXl`
white, upright, with the sticker outline (`shadow.textOutlineMd`, rim ~2.5 px) on a 30 px line pitch
(`lineHeight.description`). Right-aligned by default.

props.name: align
props.description: Horizontal alignment. Default `end` (right-aligned under the title).

props.name: maxWidth
props.description: Maximum width in design units. Default 620; `none` for no limit.

EventRibbon.description:
Subtitle ribbon under an `EventTitle` (e.g. "New Chapter Unlocked"): a full pill 44 tall (4 px black outline + 36 white body, plus a 4 px hard drop) around a `color.event.ribbonFill` body,
black centred `bodyXl` text with ~60 px side padding and a black halftone dot fade (~50 px) at both ends,
the dots shrinking toward the centre. Static text.

EventTitle.description:
Event page title: `eventTitle` 38, white, upright,
with the sticker outline: a 7 px black stroke painted behind the fill (~3.5 px visible rim) and a
hard 3 px black `drop-shadow()` of the stroked silhouette. This locally
overrides the `shadow.textEventTitle` (6 px) / `shadow.textEventTitleDrop` (4 px) tokens, whose
text-shadow would hide behind the stroke in Chrome (see EventTitle.css). Right-aligned by default.

props.name: align
props.description: Horizontal alignment. Default `end` (right-aligned, as on every event page).

props.name: as
props.description: Heading element. Default `h1` (the event page's title).

props.name: size
props.description:
Font size in design units. Default `fontSize.eventTitle` 38. Short headlines can go larger
(~46–47).

FilmStripBackground.description:
35 mm film strips (a backdrop beside a character or poster panel): vertical strips rotated −16°
(skew.watermarkRotate, leaning "\"), black sprocket edges with #1E2020 holes, frames alternating
dark windows and film-orange (`color.content.filmOrange`) poster panels with black stencils.

props.name: frames
props.description: Poster content, cycled through the orange frames. Default: original black stencil glyphs.

props.name: strips
props.description: Number of strips (2 or 3, default 3).

FilterDrawer.description:
A filter drawer (e.g. "Filter W-Engines"): a Select (460) + SortToggle row, a 4 px divider, labelled
ChipGroup sections (2 columns, 262 × 41 chips) and the orange-disc Reset button in the footer.
Generic: the sort options and the sections are data.

props.name: groups
props.description: Chip sections, as data ("Rarity" S/A/B, "Agent Specialties" …).

props.name: children
props.description: Extra content under the sections.

props.name: closeLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the header Close tag (default "Close").

props.name: closeOnEscape
props.description: Escape closes (default true).

props.name: closeOnScrim
props.description: Close when the dimmed page (scrim) is clicked (default true).

props.name: container
props.description: Render inside this element (position: absolute) instead of a fixed layer on `<body>`.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Initial open state (uncontrolled).

props.name: icon
props.description: Header glyph before the title (e.g. `<FilterIcon />`, 21 × 22).

props.name: onReset
props.description: Reset pressed.

props.name: open
props.description: Open state (controlled).

props.name: resetLabel
props.description: Default "Reset".

props.name: sort
props.description: The sort row (Select + SortToggle). Omit for no sort row.

props.name: title
props.description: Default "Filter W-Engines".

props.name: width
props.description: Drawer width in design units (default 688, `size.panel.drawerWidth`).

getFocusable.description: Focusable descendants in DOM order (used by Modal's focus trap and the menu).

getPaginationItems.description:
Page list with one sibling each side of the current page and one boundary page at each end
(e.g. `1 2 3 4 5 … 175` on page 1). Always the same number of slots once the
count exceeds them, so the bar does not jump in width.

GraffitiLayer.description:
Graffiti watermark layer: huge original wordmark / monogram lettering and micro-copy (from
`pattern.watermark.content`), rotated −16° (skew.watermarkRotate, text rising to the right) and
cropped by the frame. Draw it over black or inside the dialog band. The SVG is a fixed wide canvas
sized in design units (with --zzz-px, centred, cropped by the layer), so the lettering keeps its size in
any container.

props.name: drift
props.description:
Drift along the layer's own baseline at pattern.watermark.drift (−23.3, +6.4) px/s (dialog band).
Frozen under prefers-reduced-motion or `data-reduced-motion` on an ancestor.

props.name: variant
props.description:
`agent` (default): `color.watermark.glyph` #232323 on black, fading to
`glyphDim` #161616 toward the lower left, faint hatch (±3 levels) inside the letters only. The
black between the letters is pure #000, so put this layer over black, not over the
global HatchBackground.
`dialog`: dialog band: large shapes ≈ #181818, small print ≈ #1E1E1E (a step lighter than the
color.watermark.dialog* tokens, see Backgrounds.css).

HatchBackground.description: Full-bleed 39.8° hatch (pattern.hatch: 7.68 px perpendicular period, 12 × 10 px tile).

props.name: tone
props.description:
`black` (default): the global white-alpha hatch on black (`.zzz-bg-hatch`).
`sage` / `teal` / `deep`: the sweep-transition panels (stripes between their
light and dark colours). `{ light, dark }`: custom stripe colours.

Hero.description:
Landing / entry section for apps and pages: an accent eyebrow tag,
the sticker-outlined headline (EventTitle look), a meta line, description and bullets, primary +
secondary actions, a status/summary slot and an art slot left, right or behind the text, over a hatch,
graffiti or plain background. Responsive: below a 720 px wide container the art stacks above the text.
Labelled by its headline (`aria-labelledby`).

props.name: title
props.description: The headline (sticker-outlined EventTitle look).

props.name: actions
props.description: Extra actions after the primary / secondary buttons.

props.name: align
props.description: Text alignment. Default `start`.

props.name: art
props.description: Art slot (portrait / illustration): an ``, `` or SVG.

props.name: artFit
props.description: `contain` (default, a standing portrait anchored at the bottom) or `cover`.

props.name: artPosition
props.description: Where the art goes. Default `right`. On narrow containers `left` / `right` stack the art above the text.

props.name: background
props.description: Background layer. Default `hatch`.

props.name: bullets
props.description: Bullet list (feature list, rules).

props.name: children
props.description: Extra content after the summary.

props.name: description
props.description: Paragraph(s) of description.

props.name: eyebrow
props.description: Small accent tag above the headline ("Daily", "New season", "Beta").

props.name: headingLevel
props.description: Heading level of the headline. Default `h1`.

props.name: meta
props.description: Subtitle / meta line under the headline. An array is joined with " · " ("Puzzle #42", "Oct 1").

props.name: summary
props.description: Status / summary slot under the actions (e.g. "Already played today" + a countdown).

props.name: textOutline
props.description:
Sticker outline on the meta, description and bullets (legibility over light or busy art).
Default: on when `artPosition="background"` and art is given.

IconButton.description:
Round icon-only button: the dark pill material as a circle. Pressed follows the pill
rule (accent + outset). Disabled greys the glyph (#666).

props.name: icon
props.description: The glyph (an icon from the Zone icon set, or any SVG using `currentColor`).

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name (rendered as `aria-label`; an explicit `aria-label` prop wins). Required: the button has no visible text.

props.name: defaultPressedState
props.description: Uncontrolled initial toggle state.

props.name: iconOn
props.description: Glyph shown while a toggle is on (e.g. `LockIcon` vs `UnlockIcon`). Defaults to `icon`.

props.name: pressed
props.description: Force the momentary pressed look (accent fill + outset), for demos and tests.

props.name: pressedState
props.description: Controlled toggle state.

props.name: pressOutset
props.description: Pressed outset in design units. Default `size.control.pressOutset` (4) × the size ratio (sm ≈ 3.2, lg ≈ 4.8); an explicit value is absolute.

props.name: size
props.description: `sm` 46 · `md` 57 · `lg` 69 design units (≈ 32 / 40 / 48 px at the default scale), or a fixed preset. Default `md`.

props.name: toggle
props.description: Make it a toggle button (`aria-pressed`).

props.name: tone
props.description: Default `default`. The caller picks the look for each toggle state (e.g. `pressedState ? 'lockOn' : 'default'`).

IconTabs.description:
Category switcher: circle icon tabs in a 59 px pill, 95 px pitch. The active
tab is an 82 px accent circle overflowing the pill, with the glyph inverted on a 44 px black disc.

props.name: beat
props.description: Optional flourish: the active circle bumps 82 → 88 px every 667 ms (`motion.duration.selectionBeat`).

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initial value (uncontrolled). Default: the first enabled item.

props.name: pressed
props.description: Force the pressed look on this (inactive) tab. Docs / visual tests.

props.name: size
props.description:
Control size (default `md`). Pill height 59, slot pitch 95, glyph 45, active circle 82 / disc 44
and the ring all scale by the control-size ratio (sm 46/57, lg 69/57).

props.name: value
props.description: Selected value (controlled).

InfoPill.description:
Event timer / info pill (e.g. "66d", "Event Details"): a 36 px black full pill with
no ring, a 27 px white outline glyph inset 4 and `bodyXl` upright white text. With `onClick` it is
a button and follows the pressed rule (accent fill + 4 px outset, black label, glyph hidden).

props.name: disabled
props.description: Button pills only: disables it (label/glyph grey, shape unchanged).

props.name: icon
props.description: Leading outline glyph (27 px, white), e.g. `<ClockIcon />` for the timer or `<InfoAlertIcon />` for "Event Details".

props.name: onClick
props.description: Makes the pill a `<button>` (e.g. "Event Details" opens the rules). Without it the pill is static text.

props.name: pressed
props.description: Force the pressed look (tests). Button pills only.

InlineError.description:
Red inline error (e.g. "Insufficient crafting materials"): `color.danger.text`, upright
`fontSize.body`, centred, no icon, no plate, no entrance animation.

props.name: alert
props.description:
`role="alert"`: only when the message appears in response to a user action. Default false —
then reference it with `aria-describedby` from the disabled action.

INTERSTITIAL_COLORS.description: The default panel colours, for docs.

INTERSTITIAL_TIMING.description: Timeline (ms) of the default sweep. Same values as `SWEEP_TIMING`.

isLiveLayer.description:
A `<body>` child that must stay out of the inert page: it carries `data-zzz-live-layer`, or it is a
theme portal (`.zzz-portal`, e.g. ToastProvider's always-mounted viewport) hosting a live region.
Inerting those would drop the toast list from the accessibility tree, so a toast raised from inside
an open dialog would never be announced and its Dismiss button could not be reached. The app root
is never exempted, even when it contains a live region.

ITEM_CARD_SIZES.description: Per-size geometry. Ring/radius per size live in CSS.

ItemCard.description:
The inventory tile: W-Engine, Drive Disc, material, crafting ingredient, reward and
upgrade slot all share one construction — a 4 px `#404040` ring (radius 14), a rarity-coloured
body and a black art panel whose rounded bottom leaves the rarity "cup" band. Stars, specialty
glyph, lock disc, slot hexagon and an overhanging equipped-by avatar are optional; the level /
count capsule sits below.

Standalone it is a `<button>` whose accessible name is built from `name`, `level`, `rarity`,
`stars`, `locked` and `equippedBy`. Inside `ItemGrid` it renders as a `<div>` and the grid
cell (`role="option"`) is the focusable element. No hover, pressed or disabled look (by
design); `disabled` still disables the button.

props.name: art
props.description: Art slot (an ``, `` or SVG). It is fitted into the black art panel (`object-fit: contain`).

props.name: avatar
props.description: Equipped-by avatar (44 px circle overhanging the top-right corner). A ReactNode or an image URL.

props.name: beat
props.description: Optional selection "heartbeat": the ring contracts every 667 ms (optional flourish).

props.name: caption
props.description: Custom capsule content (overrides `level` / `count`); `false` hides the capsule.

props.name: count
props.description: Count: a number ("7") or owned / required ("20/60", owned in red when short).

props.name: empty
props.description: EMPTY slot: dark ring, black fill, broken X glyph and an "EMPTY" capsule.

props.name: equippedBy
props.description: Name of the agent the item is equipped by (accessible name only).

props.name: interactive
props.description: Render as a `<button>` (default) or as a static `<div>`. Inside `ItemGrid` it is always a `<div>`.

props.name: level
props.description: Level: renders "Lv. {level}" in the capsule below.

props.name: locked
props.description: Shows the lock disc above the band.

props.name: name
props.description: Item name. Leads the accessible name ("The Brimstone, Level 60, Rank S, Locked, …").

props.name: rarity
props.description: Rarity: colours the band under the art. Default `b`.

props.name: selected
props.description: Selected: the 7 px pulsing accent ring directly outside the grey ring.

props.name: size
props.description: Card size. Default `storage`, or the enclosing `ItemGrid`'s density.

props.name: slot
props.description: Drive-disc slot number: shows the `SlotHexBadge` at the top-left instead of the specialty glyph.

props.name: specialty
props.description: Specialty glyph, top-left (22 × 18, `color.icon.specialty`). Pass an icon, e.g. `<AttackIcon />`.

props.name: stars
props.description: Filled stars (W-Engine refinement phase). Omit for no star row.

props.name: starsMax
props.description: Star count. Default 5.

ItemGrid.description:
Inventory grid: `ItemCard`s at a fractional pitch with single selection.
`role="listbox"` of `role="option"` cells with a roving tabindex: arrow keys move in 2-D and the
selection follows focus, Home / End go to the row start / end, Ctrl+Home / Ctrl+End to the first
/ last item, Enter / Space activate. Tiles fade in with the entrance stagger; the selection ring
snaps between tiles.

props.name: columns
props.description: Columns (13 on Storage / Manage Item, 9 on Overclock, 5 on the equip list).

props.name: getId
props.description: Stable id of an item (selection value, option id suffix, React key).

props.name: renderItem
props.description: Render one tile, normally an `ItemCard` (it picks up size and selection from the grid).

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initially selected id (uncontrolled).

props.name: density
props.description: Card size and pitch. Default `storage` (118 at 135.2 × 174.7).

props.name: onActivate
props.description: Enter / Space / click on a tile (after selecting it).

props.name: scrollbar
props.description: Wrap in a `ScrollArea` with the bar on this side. Default: no scroll container.

props.name: scrollbarGap
props.description: Gap between the scroll bar and the grid's padding box (design units). Default: 14 − 7 (left) / 34 − 8 (right), i.e. a 14 / 34 bar-to-card gap.

props.name: stagger
props.description:
Entrance: each tile fades in at `33 ms + i × step`: `fast` 8.5 ms (Storage tab switch, default),
`slow` 18 ms (Manage Item entrance), `none`. Replays when the set of ids changes. Off under
reduced motion.

props.name: value
props.description: Selected id (controlled). `null` = nothing selected.

KeyHint.description:
Key hint: a 38 px key circle (3 px `#2F2F2F` ring, black) holding the upright key
letter, then an upright white label 14 px later ("T Unlock", "R Discard").

props.name: keyCap
props.description: The key shown in the 38 px circle ("T", "R").

props.name: disabled
props.description: Suspend the shortcut.

props.name: hotkey
props.description: `KeyboardEvent.key` to listen for, when it differs from `keyCap` (e.g. `keyCap="Esc"`, `hotkey="Escape"`).

props.name: label
props.description: Text after the circle ("Unlock", "Discard"). Omit for a bare key circle.

props.name: onActivate
props.description:
Registers a window keyboard shortcut for the hint. The hint is informational: the real action
lives on the associated control, so wire this to the same handler.

props.name: size
props.description: `sm` · `md` · `lg`. Default: the enclosing `KeyHints` row's size, else `md`.

KeyHints.description: A row of key hints, 48 px apart (`space.14`, × the size ratio), right-aligned by default.

props.name: align
props.description: Row alignment. Default `end` (right-aligned, as in a bottom bar).

props.name: hints
props.description: Hints as data; or pass `<KeyHint>` children.

props.name: size
props.description: Size of every hint in the row (a hint's own `size` wins) and of the gap between them. Default `md`.

Keyword.description: Orange highlight (`color.highlight.keyword` #FAAD2B) for keywords such as "Attack" or "Rupture".

props.name: icon
props.description: Optional leading icon (e.g. a specialty glyph), sized 1 em.

props.name: textRole
props.description: Optional text role; omitted = inherit the surrounding size.

LevelPill.description:
Level display. The pill is a `role="group"` named "Level 60 of 60"; the visible digits
(including the engraved ghost max) are hidden from assistive tech. Only the large variant holds a
control (the `(i)` Details sub-pill).

props.name: infoIcon
props.description: Custom glyph for the `(i)` button. Default `InfoAlertIcon`.

props.name: infoLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the `(i)` button. Default "Details".

props.name: infoProps
props.description: Extra props for the `(i)` button (`disabled`, `pressed`…).

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name of the pill. Default "Level {level} of {max}".

props.name: onInfo
props.description: Large variant: shows the `(i)` "Details" sub-pill and calls this on activation.

props.name: rank
props.description: Rarity coin (panel / equip / large). Omit to hide it.

props.name: showMax
props.description: Agent variant: show "MAX" in the black end capsule. Default `level >= max`.

midpoint.description: Default midpoint in ms: the screen is fully covered and the stack starts to exit.

MissionCard.description:
Event mission card: 581 × 150, 8 px teal
ring (radius 14) with a light notch ornament on the top-right corner; a 54 px dark header with the mission
text; an 80 px event-theme body with a teal left strip, an 80 px teal-ringed reward circle (lime tick when
claimed), a magnifier `IconButton size="mission"` and a `Button variant="mission"` (Go / Claimed / Stay Tuned).

props.name: title
props.description: Mission text in the dark header (1–2 lines; a single line renders at `bodyLg`, two at `body`).

props.name: actionLabel
props.description: Override the action label. Defaults: Go / Claimed / Stay Tuned.

props.name: inspectLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the magnifier. Default "Details".

props.name: isNew
props.description: Shows the "NEW!" tag over the header's top-right corner.

props.name: onGo
props.description: Action button ("Go"). Only fires when `status="go"`.

props.name: onInspect
props.description: Magnifier button (reward / mission details).

props.name: reward
props.description: Reward art slot (an ``, `` or SVG), fitted into the 80 px teal-ringed circle (54 px art window).

props.name: rewardLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the reward (e.g. "Outfit: Angels of Delusion").

props.name: status
props.description: Default `go`.

Modal.description:
A centred dialog panel for web pages; for full-width band dialogs prefer `DialogBand`.
A centred 450-wide panel with the asymmetric radius 20 0 20 20 (top-right square), a 3 px
black border + 3 px rgba(66,66,66,.66) outline, `linear-gradient(170deg, #222, #000 80%)`
with the rhombus grid; header min 60 on `linear-gradient(#1C1C1C, #080808)`, title in
`color.text.title`. Backdrop: a light scrim with 39.8deg stripes and a 4 px blur.

`role="dialog"` + `aria-modal`, labelled by the title, described by `description`; focus moves
in on open, Tab / Shift+Tab are trapped, Escape closes, focus returns to the opener. The modal
layer is shared with DialogBand / Drawer (`useModalLayer`): while open every sibling of the
layer root is `inert` and page scroll is locked; the page is un-inerted before focus returns.
`className` / `style` / `ref` / other div props go to the dialog panel.

props.name: title
props.description: Dialog title (its accessible name).

props.name: alert
props.description: Use `alertdialog` (confirmations that interrupt).

props.name: closeLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the close button. Default "Close".

props.name: closeOnBackdrop
props.description: Close when the backdrop is clicked. Default true.

props.name: closeOnEscape
props.description: Close on Escape. Default true.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Initial open state (uncontrolled).

props.name: description
props.description: Optional lead text under the title (its accessible description).

props.name: footer
props.description: Footer actions, right-aligned (e.g. two `Button`s).

props.name: hideClose
props.description: Hide the top-right close button.

props.name: initialFocus
props.description: Element to focus on open. Default: the first focusable element in the body / footer.

props.name: open
props.description: Controlled open state.

props.name: trigger
props.description: Optional opener: ONE button element; clicking it opens the modal (uncontrolled use).

props.name: width
props.description: Panel width in design units. Default 450.

ModifierRow.description:
Modifier row: a 69 px capsule (5 px black rim, #202020 fill) with
"Active Modifier Count" in `text.secondary`, the count in sage, and a nested dark pill button
("Combat Readiness") flush right.

props.name: count
props.description: The count, in `color.sage.base`.

props.name: action
props.description:
Right-hand button. Button props are merged over the Combat Readiness defaults (CombatBadge cap,
two-line italic "Combat / Readiness"); a React element is rendered as given. Omit for no button.

props.name: label
props.description: Default "Active Modifier Count".

ms.description: A motion duration token (e.g. tokens.motion.duration.bandOut = '60ms') in ms.

NavBar.description:
Site header: a 100 px black bar, logo left, 44 px nav pills (grey text; active/hover = white pill + scale
1.12), a lime CTA pill and round icon actions. The items fold into a menu button when they
no longer fit (the CTA too below 900 px).

props.name: actions
props.description: Right-hand slot, e.g. circular icon buttons.

props.name: collapse
props.description:
`auto` (default): the items fold into a menu button as soon as they no longer fit the bar
(measured with a ResizeObserver; the CTA stays in the bar), and the CTA folds too below
900 px of bar width (container query). `always` / `never` force either layout.

props.name: cta
props.description: Call-to-action pill after the items (e.g. "Download Now").

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initial active item (uncontrolled).

props.name: logo
props.description: Logo slot (left). Wrap it in your own link if it should navigate.

props.name: menuLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the menu button. Default `Menu`.

props.name: menuOpen
props.description: Collapsed menu open (controlled).

props.name: navLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the navigation landmark. Default `Main`.

props.name: skin
props.description: `web` (default): CTA static `#D8FA00`. `game`: CTA and menu bar in the live `--zzz-accent`.

props.name: value
props.description: Active item (controlled): `aria-current="page"` + the white pill.

NewBadge.description:
"NEW!" tag: heavy 10° italic, holographic `color.badge.newGradient` fill
(background-clip: text) over a `shadow.textNew` black stroke (~3 px visible). Static.

props.name: children
props.description: The text. Default `"NEW!"`.

props.name: offset
props.description: Overhang `[x, y]` in design units past the host corner. Default `[6, 8]`.

props.name: placement
props.description:
`top-right` (default) / `top-left`: absolutely positioned on the host's corner, overhanging it
(the host must be `position: relative`). `inline`: in the text flow.

props.name: size
props.description: `md` = 19 design units (glyphs ~51 × 16); `sm` = 17.8 (cap ~15). Default `md`.

NewsCard.description:
News article card: a 396×220
banner with only the top-right and bottom-left corners rounded (35), date + category tag,
one-line title, two-line description. The whole card is one link.

props.name: title
props.description: Headline: the link's accessible name. One line, ellipsised.

props.name: art
props.description: Banner art slot (an ``, `` or SVG). Cropped to 396×220 with `object-fit: cover`. Decorative.

props.name: category
props.description: A string renders a CategoryTag; any other node is rendered as given.

props.name: date
props.description: Date line, in the condensed face (e.g. `2024/07/04`).

props.name: description
props.description: Two-line clamped summary.

props.name: skin
props.description: Skin of the CategoryTag.

props.name: tone
props.description: `dark` (default): theme text colours (title white, description tertiary). `light`: dark text for a light page.

props.name: width
props.description: Card width in design units (default 396).

Notice.description:
Translucent notice pill (e.g. "'Unlock Early' has been unlocked"): 424 × 39,
`color.surface.notice` (black 50 %, no blur), white `label` text inset 12, a 22 px glyph 8 px
from the right end. `role="status"`.

props.name: icon
props.description: Trailing glyph (22 px, white outline). Default `InfoAlertIcon`; `null` hides it.

OverclockBar.description:
Overclock phase bar: a 544 × 56 static lime capsule (`color.progress.overclock`,
ramping to `overclockEnd` over the right segment) with the current-phase stars, four black ">"
chevrons and the next-phase stars. It does not pulse. `role="img"`.

props.name: current
props.description: Filled stars of the current phase (left group).

props.name: next
props.description: Filled stars of the next phase (right group).

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name. Default "Phase {current} → Phase {next}".

props.name: left
props.description: Replaces the left star group (decorative slot).

props.name: max
props.description: Stars per group. Default 5.

props.name: right
props.description: Replaces the right star group (decorative slot).

OverlayPortal.description:
The layer root. With `container` it is a plain absolutely positioned div inside the container's own
theme; on `<body>` it is a fixed `.zzz-theme` carrying the host's --zzz-px, accent phase and
reduced-motion flag (read from a hidden inline anchor where the component is rendered).

props.name: state
props.description: data-state of the layer root ('open' | 'closed').

props.name: container
props.description: Render into this element instead of `<body>`; the layer then fills it (position: absolute).

props.name: data
props.description: Extra data-* attributes for the layer root.

PageTitle.description:
Top-bar page title: plain upright `fontSize.title` text in
`color.text.title` (#C3C3C3, cap 25), 28 px after the Back button, e.g. "Manage Item".
It replaces the location pill.

props.name: as
props.description: Element to render. Default `h1` (the screen's title).

Pagination.description:
Pagination: a 52 px `#222122` pill, 64 px page slots, the current page on a skewed
white chip, prev/next as white end chips with black arrows.

props.name: count
props.description: Number of pages (≥ 1).

props.name: boundaryCount
props.description: Pages always shown at each end. Default 1.

props.name: defaultPage
props.description: Initial page (uncontrolled). Default 1.

props.name: getPageHref
props.description: Render links instead of buttons (server-rendered lists). Clicks still call onPageChange.

props.name: getPageLabel
props.description: Accessible name of each page control. Default `Page N`.

props.name: page
props.description: Current page, 1-based (controlled).

props.name: siblingCount
props.description: Pages shown each side of the current one. Default 1.

props.name: size
props.description:
Control size (default `md`). Track, page slots, chips, arrows, gaps and numbers scale by the
control-size ratio (sm 46/57, lg 69/57); skew angles stay; numbers never drop below the `label`
text role.

props.name: skin
props.description: Default `web` (white chips, ~40° slant, hover scale). `game` = mesh pill + accent chips at 26.5°.

Panel.description:
Framed container. `width` / `height` are the OUTER size: the ring and
keyline of `.zzz-mat-panel` are drawn outside the surface box, so the root reserves them as
padding. Renders `<section aria-labelledby>` pointing at the header label or title.

props.name: aside
props.description: `large`: the raised right column (`color.surface.raised`). The children fill the art stage on the left.

props.name: asideWidth
props.description: `large`: right column width in design units. Default 725.

props.name: footer
props.description: Footer (buttons).

props.name: headerLabel
props.description: Header strip label: "DETAIL" (side, `micro` in `text.faint`) or "Crafting" (tool, `bodyLg` in `text.panelTab`).

props.name: height
props.description: Outer height in design units (ring included). Defaults: side 670, tool 820, others auto.

props.name: lower
props.description: `tool`: textured lower section (`color.surface.panelBodyTextured` + dots lg) filling the rest of the body.

props.name: lowerTexturedFrom
props.description: `tool`: start the textured lower background at this y (design units from the top of the body), with a hard edge.

props.name: title
props.description: Title in the 70 px title band (`large`). On other variants it is rendered as the first body line.

props.name: variant
props.description: Default `side`.

props.name: width
props.description: Outer width in design units (ring included). Defaults: side 460, tool 626, others fluid.

parseEffectMarkup.description: Parse the `{kw}…{/kw}` / `{val}…{/val}` / `{b}…{/b}` markup into React nodes.

PlusBadge.description:
"Get more" disc: a 15 px `color.badge.plus` disc with a black "+" (3 px bars,
8 px span) and a 1.5 px dark ring. It is a `<button>`; its hit area extends 8 px beyond the disc.
Pressed: the disc takes the live accent and grows 1 px per side.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name, e.g. "Get more Battery Charge" (the badge shows only a "+").

prefersReducedMotion.description: Whether the reduced-motion preference applies to `el` (media query or a `[data-reduced-motion]` ancestor).

ProgressPill.description:
Stat pill (e.g. "Polychrome Progress: 19%"): ~416 × 56 capsule with the `polychromeTop` →
`polychromeBottom` gradient and a 1 px #393939 highlight. It has NO proportional fill.

props.name: label
props.description: Label, typically two lines ("Polychrome\nProgress:"); `\n` breaks the line.

props.name: value
props.description: Right-aligned value ("19%").

props.name: icon
props.description: Icon in the left well (~62 px disc, overhangs the pill), e.g. the Polychrome film card. Decorative.

props.name: isNew
props.description: Shows the NEW! badge over the icon well.

QuantityBar.description:
Quantity readout: a flat 581 × 38
`color.surface.track` pill, no ring, centred upright white `fontSize.body` text such as
"Craft Quantity × 1" (a real × sign). A polite live region, so value changes are announced.

props.name: label
props.description: Label slot ("Craft Quantity").

props.name: live
props.description: Announce changes politely (default true).

props.name: separator
props.description: Between label and value (default the multiplication sign ×).

props.name: size
props.description: Height, padding and bevel scale with the web size scale (sm = md × 46/57, lg = md × 69/57); pair it with the Slider's size. Default `md`.

props.name: value
props.description: Value slot ("1"); omitted = label only.

Radio.description:
A native radio drawn as a 24 px circle (3 px
`color.border.button` ring, 1 px black keyline). Checked: accent fill + black dot, label white.
`className` / `style` go to the root `<label>`; `ref` and other props to the `<input>`.

props.name: checked
props.description: Standalone use only (inside a RadioGroup the group decides).

props.name: size
props.description:
Circle, ring, dot and row height scale with the control scale (sm = md × 46/57, lg = md × 69/57);
the label is `fontSize.label` / `body` / `bodyLg`. Default: the group's size, else `md`.

RadioGroup.description:
A `radiogroup` of native radios sharing one name.
Arrow keys move focus and select (wrapping, skipping disabled radios), as in WAI-ARIA.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initial value (uncontrolled).

props.name: label
props.description: Group label (visible, muted; also the accessible name).

props.name: name
props.description: Shared `name` of the native radios (default: generated).

props.name: orientation
props.description: Layout of the options (default vertical).

props.name: size
props.description: Size of every radio in the group (a radio's own `size` wins). Default `md`.

props.name: value
props.description: Selected value (controlled).

RankBadge.description:
Card rank sun: the gold `color.rank.starburst*` gear with a black italic
letter, or "∞". S and A share the gold sun.

props.name: decorative
props.description: Hide from assistive tech when nearby text already says the same thing.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name. Every badge has a sensible default.

props.name: size
props.description: Size in design units. Default 37 (card footer sun, 36 × 37).

RankCoin.description:
Rarity coin: a dark `color.rarityCoin.ring` ring with a lit top-left, a gradient
body per rank (`color.rarityCoin.s` / `.a`; B uses a gradient built from `color.rarity.b`)
and a knocked-out black italic letter. Everything inside is sized in
`em` of the diameter, so `size` scales the whole coin.

props.name: decorative
props.description: Hide from assistive tech when nearby text already says the same thing.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name. Every badge has a sensible default.

props.name: size
props.description: Diameter in design units. Default 30 (level pills); 29 in the large level pill.

readDesignPx.description: One design unit (`--zzz-px`) in CSS px at the host (1 when unknown, e.g. jsdom).

readThemeVars.description: The theme context a portalled overlay must carry over from its host element.

RecommendBadge.description:
"Recommended" badge: a yellow `color.badge.recommend` thumbs-up
with two four-point sparkles and a thin dark outline, ~32 × 22 incl. sparkles, for list rows.
Static (does not pulse).

props.name: decorative
props.description: Hide from assistive tech when nearby text already says the same thing.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name. Every badge has a sensible default.

props.name: offset
props.description: Overhang `[x, y]` in design units. Default `[10, 5]`.

props.name: placement
props.description: `top-left`: overhangs the host icon's top-left (host `position: relative`). Default `inline`.

reducedTotal.description: Reduced motion: fade in, hold, fade out.

remainingScroll.description: How far the element can still scroll in `direction` (CSS px).

ResourceBar.description: Row of currency pills, right-aligned, at a 224 px pitch (2 px between the tail and the next pill).

props.name: children
props.description: Or pass CurrencyPill elements directly.

props.name: items
props.description: Pills, left to right.

RewardDialog.description:
The "Obtained" band: title, a centred row of RewardTiles and a single Confirm
(green disc, ✓) on the bottom edge line.

props.name: items
props.description: The rewards, rendered as RewardTiles 141 px apart and centred.

props.name: alert
props.description: `alertdialog` instead of `dialog` (confirmations).

props.name: backdrop
props.description: Blurred, striped scrim behind the band (default true).

props.name: closeOnEscape
props.description: Escape closes (default true).

props.name: confirmLabel
props.description: Default "Confirm".

props.name: container
props.description: Render inside this element (position: absolute) instead of a fixed layer on `<body>`.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Initial open state (uncontrolled).

props.name: freezePage
props.description: Freeze the page's accent pulse behind the dialog (default true).

props.name: initialFocus
props.description: Element to focus on open. Default: the last button of `actions` (Confirm), else the first tabbable.

props.name: onClose
props.description: Confirm pressed or Escape; the dialog then closes.

props.name: onEscapeKeyDown
props.description: Called on Escape before the dialog closes (ConfirmDialog maps it to cancel).

props.name: open
props.description: Open state (controlled).

props.name: pixelate
props.description: ~100 ms pixelated freeze of the page before the band pops in (optional).

props.name: title
props.description: Default "Obtained".

props.name: watermark
props.description: Drifting graffiti watermark inside the band (default true).

RewardPreview.description:
"Reward Preview" row: a right-aligned `bodyXl` white label
with the event-title sticker outline above a row of `ItemCard size="preview"` tiles at a ~107 pitch, clipped
at the right, with a white ">" chevron (≈17 × 31) as the scroll affordance, and an optional notice slot below.

props.name: items
props.description: Reward tiles, rendered as `ItemCard size="preview"` (95 outer) without a caption. Give each a `name` for its accessible name.

props.name: label
props.description: Heading text. Default "Reward Preview".

props.name: moreLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the ">" button. Default "More rewards".

props.name: notice
props.description: Slot under the row, e.g. `<Notice>"Unlock Early" has been unlocked</Notice>`.

props.name: onMore
props.description: The ">" affordance. With `onMore` it is a button ("More rewards"); without, it scrolls the row by one page.

props.name: visible
props.description: Tiles visible before the row clips (width = n × 107 − 20). Default 6.

RewardTile.description:
Dialog reward tile: an `ItemCard size="reward"` (116 × 118, 5 px ring, outer
radius 16, 14 px band), a black count strip 8 px below it and a two-line `label` name. Not
interactive; the count and name are its text.

props.name: name
props.description: Item name, shown on up to two lines under the count (truncated with "…").

props.name: art
props.description: Art slot (``, `` or SVG).

props.name: count
props.description: Count shown in the strip under the tile ("300"). Omit for no strip.

props.name: rarity
props.description: Rarity band colour. Default `b`.

RewardTileGroup.description: A centred row of reward tiles, 141 px apart (gap 25), rendered as a list.

Screen.description:
A full-screen app frame. Fills its
container (e.g. a `Stage` canvas): a background layer, then a column of
`<header>` (top bar + optional section strip), `<main>` (the rest) and `<footer>` (bottom bar or
a dock), with the UID footer in the bottom-right corner.

props.name: background
props.type: string | number | bigint | boolean | ReactElement<unknown, string | JSXElementConstructor<any>> | Iterable<ReactNode> | ReactPortal | Promise<...> | null

props.name: bottomBar
props.description: Bottom bar (`<BottomBar>` or your own dock), placed in the `<footer>` landmark.

props.name: entrance
props.description: Fade in from black on mount (`motion.duration.screenIn` 300 ms). Default true. Off under reduced motion.

props.name: muralSrc
props.description: `background="mural"`: mural image URL (omitted = flat dimmed band).

props.name: onBack
props.description: Escape anywhere inside the screen (focus inside it) calls this, unless a child handled it first.

props.name: sectionStrip
props.description: Section-title strip (`<SectionTitleStrip>`), directly under the top bar in the header.

props.name: signal
props.description: Signal level shown by the UID footer. Default 3.

props.name: topBar
props.description: Top bar (`<TopBar>`), placed in the `<header>` landmark.

props.name: uid
props.description: Player UID for the bottom-right `UidFooter`, or your own node.

ScreenFade.description:
Imperative fade-through-black veil for app-level transitions you drive yourself: set `active`, swap
your screen in `onDone('black')`, then clear it. Fixed over its positioned parent (position: absolute).

props.name: active
props.description: true: fade to black (220 ms ease-in) and stay black; false: leave black (`exit`).

props.name: exit
props.description: How the black clears when `active` turns false: a hard `cut` (default) or a 300 ms `fade`.

props.name: onDone
props.description: Called with 'black' once fully black, and 'clear' once cleared.

ScreenTransition.description:
Screen changes through black. Wrap the routed screen and give it a
`screenKey`; on a key change the outgoing screen stays rendered (frozen, inert) until the cut. Children of
the new screen can read `useScreenEntered()` and use `tileStagger(i)` for the grid entrance.
Reduced motion: a plain 100 ms cross-fade.

props.name: screenKey
props.description: Identity of the current screen; changing it runs the transition.

props.name: appear
props.description: Run `fadeFromBlack` on first mount.

props.name: focusOnEnter
props.description: After the transition, focus the new screen's heading (`[data-screen-heading]`, else the first h1/h2). Default true.

props.name: hold
props.description: Black hold between fade-out and the new screen, in ms (default 130, `motion.duration.blackHold`).

props.name: mode
props.description: Default `cut`.

props.name: onDone
props.description: Called when the new screen is fully shown.

props.name: reducedMotion
props.description: Force reduced motion (100 ms cross-fade). Default: the OS setting / a `data-reduced-motion` ancestor.

props.name: variant
props.description: Alias of `mode`.

SCROLL_CAP_UP_PATH.description:
Arrow-cap outline in its 9 x 8 box (design units): a bullet shape, not a plain triangle. The tip widens to the full ~7.2 px within ~4.7 rows,
