then vertical sides run ~2.8 rows down to the flat base.

SCROLL_REPEAT_DELAY.description: Hold-to-repeat timing for the arrow caps (OS-like defaults). Repeats step at most 40 px.

SCROLL_RUN_INSET.description: Distance of the thumb run from the track's outer ends: arrow inset 8 + arrow 8 + gap 7.

ScrollArea.description:
The kit scrollbar: a 20 px capsule track (`#030303`, 2 px `#2A2A2A` outline) with
9 × 8 arrow caps and a 4 px square-ended `#808080` thumb whose length is the visible fraction (it fills the
run when the content fits). It wraps NATIVE scrolling: the viewport keeps wheel, touch and keyboard
scrolling (it is focusable, `tabIndex=0`); the drawn bar is `aria-hidden` and synced to it. Arrow caps
step (hold to repeat), the track pages, the thumb drags (pointer capture). Vertical, horizontal or both;
`panel` / `list` variants draw no bar and use a `ScrollHint` instead.

props.name: alwaysShow
props.description:
Keep the bar when the content fits (thumb fills the run). Default `true`: grid bars show even when
nothing overflows. `false` hides the bar until the content overflows.

props.name: gap
props.description: Gap between the bar and the content in design units. Default 34 (right) / 14 (left, top, bottom).

props.name: hint
props.description:
Overflow affordance: `true` renders an auto `ScrollHint` at the viewport's end (down, or right when
horizontal) that shows while more content remains; or pass your own node.

props.name: horizontalSide
props.description: Horizontal bar side when `orientation="both"`. Default `bottom`.

props.name: label
props.description:
Accessible name of the scroll region (the focusable viewport gets `role="region"`). Native `aria-label` /
`aria-labelledby` are routed to the viewport too (never the role-less root); `label` wins over `aria-label`.

props.name: minThumb
props.description: Minimum thumb length in design units. Default 20.

props.name: orientation
props.description: Scroll axis. Default `vertical`. `both` draws a vertical and a horizontal bar.

props.name: side
props.description:
Side of the content the bar sits on. Vertical: `right` (default; Storage grids) or `left` (Overclock /
Manage / Equip). Horizontal: `bottom` (default) or `top`. With `both`, this is the vertical bar's side
and `horizontalSide` places the horizontal one.

props.name: step
props.description: Scroll distance of an arrow-cap click, in CSS px. Default: 25 % of the viewport (min 40).

props.name: variant
viewportClassName
props.description: Extra class on the viewport.

props.name: viewportRef
props.description: Ref to the native scrolling element.

props.name: viewportTabIndex
props.description: Viewport tabIndex. Default 0 (focusable for keyboard scrolling); -1 when its content has its own tab stops.

ScrollHint.description:
Overflow affordance: the white ▼ that overlaps a detail panel's bottom edge, the smaller
▼ over a list's clipped last row, and the heavy › that ends a horizontal row (e.g. RewardPreview).
Decorative (`aria-hidden`) unless `onClick` / `interactive`, then a `<button>` "Scroll down/right".
Pass `target` (a scroll container ref) and it shows only while more content remains that way.

props.name: direction
props.description: Which way more content lies. Default `down`.

props.name: glyph
interactive
props.description: Render as a button even without `onClick` (clicking scrolls `target`).

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name of the interactive hint. Default "Scroll down" / "Scroll right" / …

props.name: onClick
props.description:
Makes the hint a `<button>`. Called on click; unless the handler calls `preventDefault()`, the hint
then scrolls `target` a page (90 %) further in its direction.

props.name: placement
props.description:
`end` (default): absolutely positioned on the edge of the nearest positioned ancestor that the
direction points at (bottom-centre for down, right-middle for right). `static`: inline in the flow.

props.name: size
props.description: Triangle size: `panel` 32 × 15 (detail panels) or `list` 25 × 12.5 (lists). Default `panel`.

props.name: target
props.description:
Scroll container to watch (auto mode): a ref object or the element itself (e.g. from a state
callback ref). The ref is re-read after every render, so a container that mounts after the hint,
or is swapped for another node, is picked up; `null` means auto mode with nothing to watch (hidden).

props.name: threshold
props.description: Remaining distance (CSS px) below which the direction counts as fully scrolled. Default 1.

props.name: visible
props.description: Force visibility. When omitted and `target` is given, the hint shows while more content remains that way.

SectionLabel.description:
Grey section label above stat rows ("Base Stat", "Advanced Stat", "W-Engine Effect"):
`color.text.muted` #8C8C8C, `fontSize.label` (17.5) in a 20 px line box, upright, indented 16 px past the rows' left edge.

props.name: as
props.description: Heading level. Default `h3`; `div` / `p` for a non-heading label.

props.name: flush
props.description: Remove the 16 px indent (when the label is not above stat rows).

SectionTitleStrip.description:
Section-title strip: a 60 px `effect.headerStrip`
gradient band with the dot texture, under a 5 px rule and a 4 px black gap.
Title `bodyLg` upright in `color.text.subtle`, inset 141 from the left.

props.name: title
props.description: "W-Engine Storage", "Drive Disc Storage".

props.name: count
props.description: `[current, max]` → rendered as "[ 113/2000 ]" (a space inside each bracket).

props.name: headingAs
props.description: Heading element for the title. Default `h2`.

props.name: right
props.description: Right-hand content (e.g. `IconTabs`, which overlap the strip).

props.name: rule
props.description: Draw the 5 px `color.border.rule` + 4 px black above the strip. Default true.

SegmentedTabs.description:
Text tab bar (e.g. Craft / Dismantle / Destroy, Base Stats / Skills / Equipment).
A tablist with automatic activation; the active tab carries an accent fill (round outer end,
26.5° slanted inner edge; a parallelogram in the middle) that snaps to the new tab and pops.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initial value (uncontrolled). Default: the first enabled item.

props.name: pressed
props.description: Force the pressed look on this (inactive) tab: grey label + inflated indicator. Docs / visual tests.

props.name: size
props.description:
Control size (default `md`). Every length (height 59, active fill, slant caps, ring, pop) scales
by the control-size ratio (sm 46/57, lg 69/57); the italic label uses `fontSize.control.{size}`.

props.name: surface
props.description:
`black` = pure #000 track (e.g. in a top bar);
`mesh` = #090909 dot mesh (e.g. in a bottom bar).

props.name: value
props.description: Selected value (controlled).

props.name: width
props.description:
Outer width in design units. Default: 703 (`black`) / 786 (`mesh`), scaled to
the item count (234.33 / 262 per tab) and to `size`. An explicit number is literal (not
size-scaled). `'fill'` = 100% of the parent.

Select.description:
Dropdown select: a 460-wide dark pill with the value in italic
`fontSize.bodyLg` 31 px from the left and a 15 × 14 white caret 15 px from the right. Its height follows
the web control scale (md 57 units ≈ 40 CSS px at 0.7, matching TextField); `size="drawer"` gives the
compact 53-unit drawer height.

The open list is a dotted dark popover
under the trigger, 48 px items, the selected item on the live accent with a black label.

Accessibility: WAI-ARIA select-only combobox. Enter / Space / ↓ / ↑ open; ↑ ↓ Home End move
the active option; Enter / Space pick; Escape closes; typing jumps to a matching option
(while closed it selects it, like a native select). `aria-label` / `aria-labelledby` /
`aria-describedby` go to the combobox; other props go to the root wrapper.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Initial open state (uncontrolled).

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initial value (uncontrolled).

props.name: name
props.description: Form field name: renders a hidden input carrying the value.

props.name: open
props.description: Open state (controlled).

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Shown (muted) while nothing is selected.

props.name: pressed
props.description: Force the trigger's pressed look (visual tests).

props.name: size
props.description:
Control size (default `md`). Trigger height is `size.control.{sm,md,lg}` (46 / 57 / 69 units, the same
as TextField / Button); padding, caret, value text, ring, pressed outset and the open list (item height,
radius, padding) scale by the control-size ratio (sm 46/57, lg 69/57). `drawer` = the compact drawer
select, 53 units tall with md proportions (opt-in).

props.name: value
props.description: Selected value (controlled).

props.name: width
props.description:
Trigger width in design units. Default 460 (`size.control.selectWidth`) scaled to `size`; an
explicit number is literal (not size-scaled). `'fill'` = 100% of the parent (responsive forms).

SignalBars.description: The 3 green connection bars after the UID (`color.icon.signal`), 17 × 15 design units.

props.name: decorative
props.description: Hide from assistive tech.

props.name: signal
props.description: Lit bars (0–3). Default 3. Unlit bars are `color.border.button` grey.

SiteFooter.description:
Site footer: a #111 social band 64 tall with 64 px icon cells and a 2 px #1A1A1A rule, then a black body
with centred logo, policy links and legal text.

props.name: children
props.description: Extra content between the links and the legal text (ratings, language picker…).

props.name: externalSocial
props.description: Open social links in a new tab (`target="_blank"` + `rel="noopener noreferrer"`).

props.name: legal
props.description: Legal text (copyright, trademarks), centred `tiny`.

props.name: links
props.description: Legal / policy links row.

props.name: linksLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the links navigation. Default `Legal`.

props.name: logo
props.description: Logo slot, centred.

props.name: social
props.description: Social icon cells, right-aligned in the 64 px top band.

props.name: socialLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the social list. Default `Social media`.

Slider.description:
Quantity slider:
− stepper (47) · min number · 12 px `#373737` track with a 34 px metallic thumb (no filled
portion; the thumb centre travels from the track's left end to its right end) · max number · + stepper.

The thumb is `role="slider"` (←/↓ −step, →/↑ +step, PageUp/PageDown, Home/End); steppers are
buttons ("Decrease" / "Increase") that clamp and turn `aria-disabled` at their bound (they
stay focusable so keyboard focus is not lost; `disabled` makes them natively disabled). `min === max` disables
both and parks the thumb at the right end. `aria-label` / `aria-labelledby` /
`aria-describedby` go to the thumb; other props to the root.

props.name: decrementLabel
props.description: Accessible names of the steppers.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initial value (uncontrolled; default `min`).

props.name: formatBound
props.description: Formats the min / max numbers (default: the number).

props.name: getValueText
props.description: `aria-valuetext` for the thumb.

props.name: pageStep
props.description: PageUp / PageDown step (default max(step, range / 10)).

props.name: showBounds
props.description: Show the min / max numbers (default true).

props.name: showSteppers
props.description: Show the − / + stepper circles (default true).

props.name: size
props.description:
Steppers, thumb, track, number slots and the press outset scale with the web size scale
(sm = md × 46/57, lg = md × 69/57); the min / max numbers use `fontSize.control.{sm,md,lg}`
(21 / 26 / 30). Default `md`.

props.name: step
props.description: Step for arrows, steppers and snapping (default 1).

props.name: value
props.description: Value (controlled).

props.name: width
props.description: Total width in design units (default 581), at every size.

SlotHexBadge.description:
Slot number: a 38 × 36 hexagon (flat top/bottom, pointed sides),
`color.surface.slotHex` fill with a 2.5 px `#666568` outline, and a squared "techno" digit
17 × 16 in `#B4B3B6`.

props.name: slot
props.description: Drive-disc slot number (replaces the HTML `slot` attribute).

props.name: decorative
props.description: Hide from assistive tech when nearby text already says the same thing.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name. Every badge has a sensible default.

props.name: offset
props.description: Overhang `[x, y]` in design units. Default `[4.5, 2]`.

props.name: placement
props.description:
`top-left`: straddles the host card's corner (4.5 px left of it, 2 px above; the host must be
`position: relative`). `inline` (default): in flow.

SortToggle.description:
Sort-direction toggle, e.g. beside a Select:
a dark `.zzz-mat-pill` circle holding the up/down bar pair (29 × 26).

The accessible name states the CURRENT order ("Sort descending" / "Sort ascending"). There is
deliberately no `aria-pressed`: a toggle button's name must not change with its pressed state
(WAI-ARIA APG), and "Sort ascending, not pressed" would read as if ascending were off.
Ascending mirrors the glyph, so the bar with the upward head moves to the left.

props.name: defaultDirection
props.description: Initial direction (uncontrolled). Default `desc` (the drawer lists S before A before B).

props.name: direction
props.description: Current direction (controlled).

props.name: labels
props.description: Accessible names per state. Default "Sort ascending" / "Sort descending".

props.name: pressed
props.description: Force the pressed look (visual tests).

props.name: size
props.description:
Control size (default `md`): the circle is `size.control.{sm,md,lg}` (46 / 57 / 69); glyph, ring and
pressed outset scale with it.

SoundToggle.description:
Sound on/off toggle with an optional volume slider. The mute button
is the round pill IconButton with original speaker glyphs (muted / low / on); it is a toggle button
(`aria-pressed` = muted). The slider (`role="slider"`, labelled "Volume", value text "50%") sits inline
or in a popover that opens on hover, on keyboard focus, on a touch long-press of the button (which does not
toggle mute), or via `popoverOpen` / `defaultPopoverOpen` / `onPopoverOpenChange`; Escape or a pointer-down
outside closes it. An external trigger should set `aria-controls={popoverId}` so it can toggle it closed.
Fully controlled or uncontrolled; it plays no audio itself — wire `muted` / `volume` to your audio layer. Moving the slider while muted un-mutes.

props.name: buttonProps
props.description: Extra props for the mute button.

props.name: defaultMuted
props.description: Initial muted state (uncontrolled). Default false.

props.name: defaultPopoverOpen
props.description: Initial popover open state (uncontrolled). Default false.

props.name: defaultVolume
props.description: Initial volume (uncontrolled). Default 1.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name of the mute button (a toggle: pressed = muted). Default "Mute".

props.name: longPressDelay
props.description: Touch long-press delay in ms that opens the popover. Default 450.

props.name: muted
props.description: Muted (controlled). The button is `aria-pressed` while muted.

props.name: onPopoverOpenChange
props.description:
Called when the popover asks to open or close: a touch long-press of the button opens it (without
toggling mute); Escape or a pointer-down outside closes it (except on an element whose `aria-controls`
names `popoverId` — your own trigger).

props.name: popoverId
props.description:
`id` of the popover element (default: generated). Give your own popover trigger
`aria-controls={popoverId}`: a pointer-down on an element that controls the popover is not treated as an
outside dismiss, so the trigger can toggle it closed again.

props.name: popoverOpen
props.description:
Popover open state (controlled). Maps to `data-open` on the root; hover and keyboard focus still open it
visually on top of this. Only used with `volumeControl="popover"`.

props.name: popoverPlacement
props.description: Popover side. Default `bottom`.

props.name: size
props.description:
Mute-button size: the shared control scale `sm` 46 · `md` 57 · `lg` 69 design units (≈ 32 / 40 / 48 px at
the default scale; the button-to-slider gap follows it), or an IconButton preset size. Default `md`.

props.name: sliderWidth
props.description: Slider track width in design units. Default 240.

props.name: step
props.description: Volume step for arrows / snapping. Default 0.05.

props.name: volume
props.description: Volume 0–1 (controlled), the scale of `HTMLMediaElement.volume`.

props.name: volumeControl
props.description: Default `none` (mute button only).

props.name: volumeLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the volume slider. Default "Volume".

SpeakerIcon.description: Speaker with two sound waves (sound on).

SpeakerLowIcon.description: Speaker with one sound wave (low volume).

Spinner.description:
Loading spinner: a conic ring, or (`chevrons`) the hatched chevron panels of the sweep
transition.
`role="status"` with a visually-hidden label; rotation / sweep stop under reduced motion.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible status text (visually hidden). Default "Loading".

props.name: size
props.description: Height in design units. Default 40 (ring) / 44 (chevrons).

props.name: tone
props.description: Ring colour. Default `accent`. (The chevrons use the interstitial sage / teal / deep.)

props.name: variant
props.description: Default `ring`.

Splash.description:
Full-screen "press to enter" gate: logo / art slot, title, subtitle and
a softly pulsing hint over a graffiti, hatch or plain background. Apps use it to get the user gesture that
browsers require before audio can play. Click / tap anywhere, Enter or Space dismisses it (the enter button
is focused on open); it then fades out (300 ms) and unmounts. Rendered as a modal `dialog` labelled by the
title; while open its sibling elements are `inert` and Tab stays inside, so render it next to your app
content (e.g. first child of the app root). Reduced motion: no pulse, no fade.

props.name: background
props.description: Background layer. Default `graffiti`.

props.name: contained
props.description: Fill the nearest positioned ancestor (position: absolute) instead of the viewport (fixed).

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Initially shown (uncontrolled). Default true.

props.name: footer
props.description: Small print at the bottom (version, credits).

props.name: hint
props.description: Pulsing hint, also the accessible name of the enter button. Default "Press to enter".

props.name: logo
props.description: Logo / art slot above the title.

props.name: onEnter
props.description:
Called synchronously inside the dismissing click / key event — a user gesture, so it is the place to
unlock audio (`audioContext.resume()`, `audio.play()`).

props.name: open
props.description: Shown (controlled).

props.name: subtitle
props.description: Line under the title.

props.name: title
props.description: Title (sticker-outlined, large).

SPLASH_EXIT_MS.description: Fade-out length in ms after dismissing.

SplitPill.description:
Two-part tag pill (e.g. element / specialty): the level-pill shell (66 px incl. the 5 px black
rim) split by the 24° divider; each half holds an icon and a `bodyXl` label in `text.secondary`.
Rendered as a two-item list.

props.name: items
props.description: The two halves, e.g. element + specialty.

Stage.description:
Optional artboard for full-screen, game-style scenes: a fixed canvas (default 1920 x 1080 design
units) that scales as one picture to fit its container, like a game screen or a slide.

It is NOT how ordinary pages are sized. Pages and components use the web-standard, rem-based
density (`--zzz-scale`, default 0.7) and lay themselves out responsively; reach for Stage only
when a composition must keep a fixed aspect and scale as a whole (a title screen, a mock of a
game menu, a hero scene).

The outer box is a size container (it needs a definite size; with an auto height it falls back
to the artboard's aspect ratio). The inner canvas is a `.zzz-theme` whose `--zzz-px` is derived
from the container (`fit`), so everything inside is laid out in design units.

props.name: fit
height
props.description: Artboard height in design units. Default 1080.

props.name: width
props.description: Artboard width in design units. Default 1920 (16:9).

StarRating.description:
Star rating: five-point stars with slightly rounded tips, filled from the left.
Filled `color.star.filled`, empty `color.star.empty` (a flat grey, not an outline). Display only:
`role="img"` with an "n of max stars" label.

props.name: value
props.description: Filled stars, 0–max (clamped; fractions round down).

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name. Default "`n` of `max` stars".

props.name: max
props.description: Number of stars. Default 5.

props.name: outline
props.description:
Black outline with a small drop to the lower right (1.5 px; 2 px on lime). Default on (it only
shows on art, lime or the grey pill fills).

props.name: size
props.description:
`card` 13×14 at 16.2 pitch (item cards), `pill` 23×24 at 28.8 (side-panel stars pill),
`bar` 23 at 32 (equip-list bar), `large` 24 at 34 (big-panel stars pill), `onLime` 23 at 32
with a 2 px outline (Overclock bar). Default `card`.

StarsPill.description:
The stat pill that holds the refinement stars, optionally ending in the Enhance
">>" sub-pill (pressed = live accent fill, black chevrons, 88 × 61) or any `action` node.

props.name: value
props.description: Filled stars (refinement phase), 0–max.

props.name: action
props.description: A custom right-end slot (replaces the built-in Enhance button).

props.name: empty
props.description: Drive discs have no refinement: show a dim condensed "EMPTY" instead of stars.

props.name: enhanceLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the built-in Enhance button. Default "Enhance".

props.name: enhanceProps
props.description: Extra props for the built-in Enhance button (`disabled`, `data-pressed`, …).

props.name: max
props.description: Default 5.

props.name: onEnhance
props.description: Shows the built-in Enhance ">>" sub-pill (81 × 57) at the right end and calls this on activation.

props.name: size
props.description:
`panel`: 200 × 44 `color.surface.statRow` capsule in the side DETAIL panel, stars `pill` size, centred.
`large`: 297 × 57 `#212121` capsule in the big item panel, stars `large` size. Default `panel`.

props.name: starsLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the stars. Default "n of max stars".

StatGrid.description: A `<dl>` of StatRows in 1–2 columns with per-variant gaps.

props.name: columns
props.description: 1 or 2 columns. Default 1.

props.name: variant
props.description: Default variant for the rows and the gaps: `grid` 14 / 21, `agent` 15 / 21 (pitch 52), `panel` / `equip` 12.

StatRow.description:
Label/value capsule. A standalone row is its own `<dl>`; inside `StatGrid` it is a
`<div>` group of the grid's `<dl>` (`dt` = label, `dd` = value).

props.name: label
props.description: Stat name ("Base ATK"). Rendered as the `<dt>`.

props.name: value
props.description: Stat value ("684", "30%"). Rendered as the `<dd>`, tabular figures.

props.name: fit
props.description:
Long labels: `true` shrinks the label to fit (never below 16 design units, "Anomaly Proficiency");
`'wrap'` sets it on two tight lines at ~15 px ("Automatic Adrenaline Accumulation").

props.name: highlight
props.description: Label AND value in `color.highlight.keyword` (the orange agent stats: HP, CRIT Rate…).

props.name: icon
props.description: Optional leading glyph before the label (decorative).

props.name: rollCount
props.description: Drive-disc sub-stat roll count: appends an orange "+n" tag after the label.

props.name: variant
props.description: Default `panel`, or the enclosing StatGrid's variant.

StatTile.description:
One stat: label, big sheared value, optional sub-label / delta / icon, on the dark panel
material (`.zzz-mat-panel`: #333 lit ring + black keyline drawn OUTSIDE the box, top-lit
hero gradient inside). A standalone tile is its own `<dl>`; inside `StatTiles` it is a
`<div>` group of the grid's `<dl>`.

props.name: label
props.description: What is measured ("Played", "Win rate"). Rendered as the `<dt>`.

props.name: value
props.description: The big number ("42", "87%", "1:42"). Rendered as the `<dd>`.

props.name: delta
props.description: Change indicator. A number is signed (+3 / −2) and picks its own tone.

props.name: deltaTone
props.description: Default: from the sign of a numeric `delta`, else `neutral`.

props.name: highlight
props.description: Accent ring + accent label: the stat to look at first.

props.name: icon
props.description: Decorative glyph next to the label (aria-hidden).

props.name: size
props.description: Size when used outside StatTiles. Default `md`, or the grid's size.

props.name: sub
props.description: Secondary line under the value ("Top 12% today", "best 7").

StatTiles.description:
Responsive grid of StatTiles (a `<dl>`): dashboards, profile summaries, results screens.
Reserves room around the tiles for their outside ring + keyline.

props.name: columns
props.description: Fixed column count. Default: as many columns of at least `minTileWidth` as fit.

props.name: minTileWidth
props.description: Minimum tile width in design units for the auto-fit grid. Default 220 (sm 190).

props.name: size
props.description: Default `md`.

StatusCheck.description:
"Completed" tick: a `color.icon.check` green check with a thin black outline on a
list icon's top-left. Static.

props.name: decorative
props.description: Hide from assistive tech when nearby text already says the same thing.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name. Every badge has a sensible default.

props.name: offset
props.description: Overhang `[x, y]` in design units. Default `[12, 3]`.

props.name: placement
props.description: `top-left`: on the host icon's top-left corner (host `position: relative`). Default `inline`.

StatusGrid.description:
A row / grid of small status tiles (rounded squares with the item-card ring and the black
keyline): quiz results, streak histories, uptime bars, achievement boards.

Renders a `<ul>` (give it an `aria-label`); each cell is `role="img"` named
`label: status word` (e.g. "Q1: Correct") with an aria-hidden glyph, so the colour is never the only carrier.

props.name: columns
props.description: Fixed column count (CSS grid). Default: cells flow and wrap.

props.name: glyphs
props.description: Status glyphs inside the cells (check / cross / ! / –) so colour is never the only cue. Default true.

props.name: hideLabels
props.description: Keep the item labels for screen readers only (no captions under the cells).

props.name: size
props.description: Default `md`.

props.name: statusLabels
props.description: Accessible words per status. Defaults: Success, Error, Warning, Neutral, Empty.

StepProgress.description:
Horizontal step indicator for quizzes, wizards, onboarding and checkout. Each step is pending,
current (accent, pulsing ring), complete, success (green), error (red) or skipped.
Variants: `pips` (slanted bars, compact), `capsules` (numbered pills with labels, ellipsised on
narrow screens) and `text` ("Step 3 of 5"). An `<ol>` with `aria-current="step"` and per-step
status text; presentational (not interactive).

props.name: steps
props.description: Number of steps, or one item per step.

props.name: current
props.description: 0-based index of the current step. Default 0. Pass `steps.length` (or -1) when nothing is current.

props.name: formatText
props.description: Text variant content. Default `{stepName} {n} of {total}` with n emphasised.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name of the list. Default "Progress".

props.name: size
props.description:
Default `md`. Pips 28 × 8 / 44 × 12 / 53 × 15, capsules 32 / 41 / 50 tall (capsule label and
disc text never below `fontSize.label`, 17.5 units), text
`fontSize.control.{sm,md,lg}` (21 / 26 / 30) design units. `lg` scales every md length by 69/57.

props.name: statusLabels
props.description: Accessible words per status, e.g. `{ success: 'correct', error: 'wrong' }` for a quiz.

props.name: stepName
props.description: Noun used in the text variant and the per-step accessible text. Default "Step" ("Question", "Round"…).

props.name: variant
props.description: 'pips' (default, compact slanted bars), 'capsules' (numbered pills with labels) or 'text' ("Step 3 of 5").

StorageMuralBackground.description:
Dimmed mural band behind a top bar (101 tall). A black veil at 82 % caps every
pixel at `color.bg.artMax` #2E2E2E (255 × 0.18 = 46). The layer itself is `color.bg.artMax`, so
with no `src` the band reads ≈ #080808 — the tone of a typical mural behind the veil.

props.name: src
props.description: Mural image URL (any `src`), cover-cropped and dimmed by the veil. Omitted = a flat dimmed band (`color.bg.artMax` under the veil, ≈ #080808). The image stays invisible until it has fully loaded and then fades in (no progressive / partial paint); while it loads, or if the URL fails (the failed `` is removed, so no broken-image glyph), the same flat band shows.

SWEEP_COLORS.description: The `default` tone's panel colours, for docs.

SWEEP_TIMING.description:
Sweep timeline. `duration` scales the whole sweep; the midpoint
stays at the same fraction (567 / 933). Reduced motion always runs a fixed 400 ms quick fade.

sweepTones.description: Resolve a `tone` to the three hatch tones.

SweepTransition.description:
Full-screen sweep transition, inspired by the game's "AGENT SELECT" wipe: a black
centre band grows with a tracked condensed italic label, three hatched chevron panels sweep
in from the right, the stack exits left revealing the new content, the label blinks and the band collapses
(~930 ms by default). Use it between steps, levels, questions or routes.

Trigger with `active` (rising edge) or `runKey` (each new value). Swap content in `onMidpoint`. Decorative
(`aria-hidden`): announce the new content yourself (focus its heading or use a live region).
Reduced motion: a 400 ms quick fade.

props.name: active
props.description: Rising edge (false → true) plays the sweep once; set it back to false (e.g. in `onDone`) to arm it again.

props.name: at
props.description: Freeze the timeline at this time in ms (of `duration`) for demos / visual tests; renders regardless of `active`.

props.name: container
props.description: Render inside this element (position: absolute) instead of a fixed layer on `<body>`.

props.name: duration
props.description: Total length in ms (default 933). Every keyframe scales with it.

props.name: label
props.description: Band text (e.g. "Question 3", "Loading", "Stage Clear"). Shown tracked, condensed, upper-case.

props.name: onDone
props.description: The sweep has finished and unmounted.

props.name: onMidpoint
props.description: The screen is fully covered: swap the content underneath here.

props.name: reducedMotion
props.description: Force (true) or suppress (false) the reduced-motion quick fade. Default: the OS setting / a `data-reduced-motion` ancestor.

props.name: runKey
props.description:
Keyed mode: every new non-null value plays the sweep (also on mount), e.g. `runKey={questionIndex}`.
Can be combined with `active`.

props.name: tone
props.description: Panel colours. Default `default` (sage / teal / deep).

Switch.description:
Small toggle switch: a 76 × 45 `#161616` bezel with a black keyline, a
62 × 33 grey gradient track and a ~31 px dark knob with a light "LED" dash on its left.

On: the knob slides to the right end (120 ms out-expo) and
the LED dash turns `var(--zzz-accent)`. `role="switch"` + `aria-checked`; Space / Enter toggle.
Name it with `aria-label`, `aria-labelledby` or a `<label htmlFor>`.
Sizes `sm` / `md` / `lg` scale the whole control with the web size scale (md = the base geometry).

props.name: checked
props.description: On (controlled).

props.name: defaultChecked
props.description: Initial state (uncontrolled).

props.name: size
props.description: Bezel, track, knob and travel scale together (sm = md × 46/57, lg = md × 69/57). Default `md`.

Table.description:
Data table for web data lists (history, leaderboards, results). Semantic `<table>`: radius 10, header row #1C1C1C with `label` in
`color.text.muted`, body rows #000 with 2 px #232323 dividers, cells padding 10, centred,
tabular numbers. Optional sortable headers (button + `aria-sort`), controlled or uncontrolled.

props.name: bordered
props.description: Column dividers as well as row dividers.

props.name: caption
props.description: Table caption (its accessible name).

props.name: defaultSort
props.description: Initial sort (uncontrolled).

props.name: empty
props.description: Shown in a full-width row when `rows` is empty.

props.name: hideCaption
props.description: Keep the caption for assistive tech only.

props.name: manualSort
props.description: Do not reorder `rows` (the caller sorts, e.g. server-side); headers still report the sort.

props.name: rowKey
props.description: Row key. Default: the row index.

props.name: sort
props.description: Current sort (controlled; `null` = unsorted).

TabPanel.description:
`role="tabpanel"` wired to a tab of a SegmentedTabs / IconTabs that has the same `id`
(`aria-labelledby` the tab, and the tab's `aria-controls` points here). Render only the active
panel, or render all and set `hidden` on the inactive ones.

props.name: tabsId
props.description: The `id` given to the SegmentedTabs / IconTabs that controls this panel.

props.name: value
props.description: The tab value this panel belongs to.

TAG_BUTTON_PATH.description:
The Back tag outline, viewBox 0 0 90 58, drawn on the stroke centreline 2.5 in from the
box: right side a semicircle, left side slanted 30° (skew.backButton) with rounded corners.
Close uses the same path mirrored.

TagButton.description:
Back / Close tag button. Pressed: the whole tag fills with the live
accent and grows 2.5 px per side (89×57 → 94×62), the ring and interior vanish, the glyph turns
black. Hover: nothing.

props.name: kind
props.description: `back`: top-left red outline tag (semicircle right, 30° slant left). `close`: the mirror, red-filled (drawer header).

props.name: icon
props.description: Replace the glyph (default U-turn arrow / ×).

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name. Default "Back" / "Close".

props.name: pressed
props.description: Force the pressed look (tests).

props.name: size
props.description: `sm` · `md` (default, the 90×58 tag) · `lg` — the shared control scale.

Text.description:
Every piece of text. Maps `role` → `.zzz-text-<role>` and `tone` → `.zzz-tone-<tone>`
(from base.css), plus italic / outline / deboss / tracking / auto-fit.

props.name: ariaRole
props.description: ARIA role forwarded to the element (because `role` is the text role).

props.name: as
props.description: Element to render (default `span`).

props.name: deboss
props.description: Debossed text: `shadow.textDeboss`, tone `engraved` unless given.

props.name: fit
props.description:
Auto-shrink to the element's width, never below 16 design units.
The element becomes a single-line block: give it (or its parent) a width.

props.name: italic
props.description: 10° synthetic italic: wraps the content in `.zzz-italic` (inline-block skewX(-10deg)).

props.name: outline
props.description: Stroke drawn behind the fill (`-webkit-text-stroke` + `paint-order: stroke fill`).

props.name: role
props.description:
Typographic role. NOTE: this is the *text* role, not the ARIA `role`
attribute; pass an ARIA role through `ariaRole` if you need one.

props.name: tabular
props.description:
Tabular figures (`font.numeric.tabular`), default false: the theme's plain figures. CAUTION: with
the Mona Sans fallback tnum draws a slashed 0 and a footed 1; prefer `Zeros` for aligned counters.

props.name: tone
props.description: Text colour. Omitted = inherit (deboss defaults to `engraved`).

props.name: tracked
props.description: `name`: +0.44 em, `#323232` (name watermark); `interstitial`: +1.75 em (sweep-transition label).

TextField.description:
A text input on the dark pill (`.zzz-mat-pill`), value upright white, placeholder
`color.text.disabled`, optional leading icon cap. Sizes sm / md / lg = 46 / 57 / 69 design units
tall (`--zzz-size-control-{sm,md,lg}`), value text `fontSize.body` / `bodyLg` / `button`.
Focus: the ring turns `var(--zzz-accent)`. Error: ring `color.danger.base` + a message.
Disabled: fill #2E2E2E, text #808080.

`className` / `style` / `width` style the root; `ref` and every other prop go to the `<input>`.
Native `value` / `defaultValue` / `onChange` keep working (controlled or uncontrolled).

props.name: description
props.description: Helper text under the field (described-by).

props.name: error
props.description: `true` = invalid ring only; a node = invalid ring + the message under the field (described-by).

props.name: icon
props.description: Leading icon cap: a circle as tall as the pill with its own ring, glyph white. Decorative.

props.name: label
props.description: Visible label above the field (also its accessible name).

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the new string on every change (alongside the native `onChange`).

props.name: size
props.description:
Height of the field: `sm` 46, `md` 57 (default), `lg` 69 design units — about 32 / 40 / 48 CSS px
at the default scale. Value text, label, icon cap and ring scale with it. (Not the native
`<input size>` character count; set the width with `width` or CSS.)

props.name: width
props.description: Field width in design units (default: fill the container).

ThemePortal.description: Portal to `<body>` wrapped in a `.zzz-theme` that carries the host's scale and accent phase.

props.name: host
props.description: Element whose theme (scale, pinned accent phase) the portal inherits.

thumbMetrics.description:
Thumb math: length = visible fraction of the run (at least `min`), offset = progress × the free run.
Without a minimum this equals `run × scrollPos / scrollSize` (the thumb maps the content 1:1).

tileStagger.description:
Props for one tile of an entrance stagger: `className` + `--i`. Tiles fade 0 → 1 in 100 ms with a delay
of 33 ms + i × 8.5 ms (`motion.duration.tileStagger`) or i × 18 ms with `slow`
(`tileStaggerSlow`). The animation runs when the tile mounts.

Toast.description:
Toast notification: a 34-tall black full pill, `fontSize.label` white, padding 0 17, with a coloured icon disc
(info = `color.icon.recycle` blue, success = `color.icon.confirm` green, error =
`color.icon.cancel` red, black glyph). Success / error mix the status colour 50/50 with black
(fill) and white (text). Enter: the pill grows from its centre over 630 ms under three 70 ms
white/black flashes, the text fades in over 420 ms. Use it through `ToastProvider` + `useToast`.

props.name: animate
props.description: Play the enter animation (grow + 3× flash). Default true.

props.name: dismissLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the close button. Default "Dismiss".

props.name: icon
props.description: Glyph in the icon disc (default per variant). `null` hides the disc.

props.name: live
props.description:
Announce itself: `role="status"` (`role="alert"` for error). Default true. ToastProvider
turns it off for info / success because its list is already an `aria-live="polite"` region.

props.name: onDismiss
props.description: Renders a close button that calls this.

props.name: variant
props.description: Default `info`. Picks the icon disc colour; success / error also tint the pill.

props.name: duration
props.description: Default auto-dismiss time in ms. Default 4000.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name of the notifications region. Default "Notifications".

props.name: max
props.description: Toasts shown at once; the rest wait in the queue. Default 3.

Tooltip.description:
Tooltip: a `rgba(0,0,0,.6)` bubble, radius 10, padding 10/14, `fontSize.label` white, a 12×10 arrow,
16 px from the anchor, 300 ms opacity. Shown on hover (after `delay`) and on focus; Escape
dismisses. Placement top/bottom/left/right with a simple collision flip; the bubble is
portalled to `<body>` (never clipped) and keeps the host's `--zzz-scale`.

`className` / `style` / `ref` / other div props go to the bubble (`role="tooltip"`).

props.name: children
props.description: The trigger: ONE focusable element (button, link, input…). It gets `aria-describedby`.

props.name: content
props.description: Bubble content.

props.name: closeDelay
props.description: Delay before hiding after the pointer leaves, ms. Default 100.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Initial open state (uncontrolled).

props.name: delay
props.description: Hover delay before showing, ms. Default 300. Focus shows immediately.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Never open.

props.name: open
props.description: Controlled open state.

props.name: placement
props.description: Preferred side; flips to the opposite side when it does not fit. Default `top`.

TopBar.description:
Top bar: a full-width band 102 tall with a vertically centred controls row, side margins
68 / 66. No bottom line (the section rule belongs to `SectionTitleStrip`). `Screen` places it in its `<header>` landmark.

props.name: background
props.description:
Band fill: `solid` black (sub-pages, default), `translucent` (Home, `color.bg.topBarHome`
rgba(0,0,0,.68)), `none` (agent screens), `mural` (Storage: the dimmed mural band).

props.name: backLabel
props.description: Back button accessible name. Default "Back".

props.name: backProps
props.description: Extra props for the Back `TagButton` (e.g. `pressed`).

props.name: left
props.description:
Left group after the Back button (24 px gaps): a location `Button` ("City" with the house cap),
a title pill (avatar cap, two lines), a `Chip`…

props.name: muralSrc
props.description: `background="mural"`: mural image URL (omitted = flat dimmed band).

props.name: onBack
props.description: Renders the red Back tag button and calls this on click.

props.name: right
props.description: Right group, right-aligned (66 from the right edge): `ResourceBar`, `IconTabs`, `Button`s / `IconButton`s, `ProgressPill`…

props.name: title
props.description: Page title ("Manage Item"): rendered as a `PageTitle` 28 px after the Back button.

total.description: Default total in ms (the band collapses to 0 at 933 ms).

UidFooter.description:
"UID: 1000000001" (`fontSize.tiny`, `color.text.uid`, upright) + `SignalBars` 7 px after it.
It sits at the bottom-right corner of a screen; `Screen` positions it there.

props.name: uid
props.description: Player UID, e.g. "1000000001".

props.name: hideSignal
props.description: Hide the signal bars.

props.name: signal
props.description: Signal strength shown by the bars. Default 3.

useFloatingPosition.description:
Keeps a `position: fixed` element placed next to its anchor while `open`
(updated on scroll / resize). Returns the inline style and the resolved side.

useModalLayer.description:
Modal behaviour. Returns an onKeyDown for the dialog element (Escape + Tab trap).
Order on close: page un-inerted BEFORE focus goes back to the opener (an inert trigger can't take focus).

props.name: active
props.description: True while the layer is open (not while it animates out).

props.name: dialogRef
props.description: The dialog element (focus fallback, Tab trap root).

props.name: layerRef
props.description: The portal root (its siblings become inert).

props.name: lockScroll
props.description: Lock page scroll (not for contained layers).

props.name: freezeAccent
props.description: Freeze the accent pulse of the page behind (a dialog backdrop freezes the page pulse).

props.name: getInitialFocus
props.description: Element to focus on open; default the first tabbable in the dialog, else the dialog.

props.name: onEscape
props.description: Escape pressed and not handled by a child (e.g. an open Select).

usePresence.description: Mount/exit bookkeeping. `open` true → mounted + 'open'; false → 'closed' for `exitMs`, then unmounted.

useScreenEntered.description:
True once the current screen is visible (after the cut / during its fade-in); false while the
outgoing screen is still showing. Grids use it to start their tile stagger after the cut.

useToast.description: The toast API of the nearest `ToastProvider`.

Value.description: Green highlight (`color.highlight.value` #2CA306) for numbers in effect text ("3.5%").

props.name: textRole
props.description: Optional text role; omitted = inherit the surrounding size.

VoicePill.description:
Voice-sample pill: 392×57 pill with a 6 px ring, a 57 px round play button whose mic
glyph fills bottom-up with the playback progress, then "CV:" + the voice actor.

props.name: name
props.description: Voice-actor name.

props.name: defaultPlaying
props.description: Initial playing state (uncontrolled). Default false.

props.name: label
props.description: Leading caption. Default `CV:`.

props.name: playing
props.description: Playing state (controlled).

props.name: playLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the play button. Default `Play voice sample`.

props.name: progress
props.description:
Playback progress 0..1: fills the mic glyph bottom-up and is exposed as a progressbar.
When omitted the glyph is fully filled while playing and empty otherwise.

props.name: progressLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the progressbar. Default `Playback progress`.

props.name: skin
props.description: Fill colour: `web` = static `#BFDB5A`, `game` = the live `--zzz-accent`. Default `web`.

props.name: tone
props.description: `dark` (default): the dark pill. `light`: an #E8E8E8 pill with a black ring.

props.name: trailing
props.description: Right-hand slot, e.g. a language toggle.

WebTabs.description:
Web section tabs: a 64 px pill track, 195 px items, the active item on a skewed chip.
Keyboard/ARIA behaviour is shared with SegmentedTabs (`useTabList`).

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initial value (uncontrolled). Default: the first enabled item.

props.name: pressed
props.description: Force the pressed look on this (inactive) tab — game skin only. Docs / visual tests.

props.name: size
props.description:
Control size (default `md`). Track height (64 web / 59 game), padding, chip, label and ring scale
by the control-size ratio (sm 46/57, lg 69/57); skew angles stay; the label never drops below the
`label` text role.

props.name: skin
props.description: Default `web`.

props.name: value
props.description: Selected value (controlled).

props.name: width
props.description:
Outer width in design units (default 40 + 195 per tab = 820 for 4 tabs, scaled to `size`). An
explicit number is literal (not size-scaled); `'fill'` = 100%.

XpBar.description:
XP bar: 174 × 13 full-round, `color.progress.xp` indigo → cyan gradient (fixed to
the bar, the fill reveals it), italic white `micro` label inside, 5 px from the left. `role="progressbar"`.
The empty track uses `progress.xpTrack`.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible name. Default "Level progress".

props.name: label
props.description: Text inside the bar. Default "MAX / MAX" (thin spaces) when full, else "value / max".

Zeros.description:
Zero-padded counter: "000" in `color.text.zeroPad`, then the significant digits in white
(currency "00076418"). Screen readers get the plain number.

props.name: value
props.description: The number (non-negative integer).

props.name: digits
props.description: Total digit count; missing leading digits are drawn as dimmed zeros (default 8).

ZZZ_DEFAULT_SCALE.description:
The library's default `--zzz-scale` (tokens.css): 1 design unit = 0.7 CSS px at the browser's
default 16 px font size, i.e. ~40 px md controls and ~14 px body text, like other web design
systems.

ZzzTheme.description:
Theme root: a `<div class="zzz-theme">` that scopes the design tokens, the type baseline
and the accent clock, and can re-scale everything inside it. Without `scale` it keeps the
surrounding density (the 0.7 web default unless an ancestor changed it).

props.name: accentPhase
props.description:
Accent clock. Omit to share the page clock. `'lime' | 'mid' | 'yellow'` pin the accent
(visual regression, static mocks); `'live'` runs a clock of its own (e.g. inside a pinned
ancestor).

props.name: reducedMotion
props.description: Freeze the accent at lime regardless of the OS setting.

props.name: scale
props.description:
UI density. Omit it (the usual case) to inherit the surrounding scale: the page default is
`0.7` (`ZZZ_DEFAULT_SCALE`), set on `:root` by tokens.css, so an md control is ~40 px and body
text ~14 px at a 16 px root font size. Every length is rem-based (`--zzz-px` =
`calc(1rem / 16 * var(--zzz-scale))`), so it follows the browser font size and zoom, not the
screen resolution.
- a number sets `--zzz-scale` for the subtree: `0.5` compact, `0.7` web default, `1` game
  density (57 px pills, 20 px body).
- `'viewport'` sets `--zzz-px: calc(100vh / 1080)`, scaling with the window height like a
  game screen. Use it only for full-screen game-style scenes (title screens, menus that fill the
  window); ordinary pages should not size text by the viewport.
